text: I started playing this through free cash. I knew it was too good to be true. It was a bait and switch with the way they advertised it. You can't play like they advertised except for when you first start. Well, it was actually, playing itself LOL I was still ready to play it and spend a few dollars. Not at the level that PTW players are spending. I think I am just going to delete it. Especially after I read a few of these reviews, about losing everything they had worked for be lost in one sec.

Deceptive. Why put so much effort into all the content when you advertise only a minimal part of the game? The art style is pretty cool, and the gameplay is actually more interesting than the usual matching game. The content is a bit overwhelming though with all the supplementary stuff you have to do, and the UI doesn't do much to help. I'd give it a solid 3 stars, minus one for pretending to be one of those running soldier math games.

I enjoy this game, but please be honest in your advertising. The ads we see where you're standing on a road shooting zombies comprise a very small portion of the game. There is no need for that kind of deception. This game is very enjoyable as there are events of all kinds and new states are continually opened so that players of similar strength/experience are grouped together (which is something that games like Mobile Strike never did very well).

its a pay to win game if you want to grow quickly or earn any of the cool stuff from events. I've been playing 4 years, I'm decent but not a big player unfortunately, because I won't spend a fortune to advance, i wish things weren't so costly. overall, it's a pretty fun game. The past few months have been super glitchy with kicking off the game a lot! about every 10 min, if im lucky I can get an hour in. I have reported it, I've taken every single step to fix it, still exactly same as before. );

I've been playing this for years. My rating had started as a 4, went to 5, over the last year has declined to 2, and is progressively moving for 1. There is a constant and consistent issue with updates where the devs want to "fix" things that are not broken and yet do nothing for the things that are broken or are in serious need of tweaking. The game has moved from free to play to pay to progress in the simplest of quests and events. Hopefully, there will soon be an overview to improve this🤞🤞

I dont know what some people are saying about false advertisement.. they haven't played long enough to see what's in the ads IS in the game..I found this game through freecash app.. highly enjoyed it.. one of my favorite so far that I found through freecash app.. I love that it has multiple things to do in the game.. Zombies, War, Puzzle, Mini-games.. I found myself playing for hours.. lol

Been playing this game for 5 years... The game is decent, certain events are fun, better if you have a great team to play with (alliance) but very costly if you plan on competing. The "free" stuff gives you just enough to play and maybe have fun but ALL of the good stuff cost money. You can only do so much before you have start paying to play/compete!

This game COULD be 'okay' (or at least better), but there are some BIG "Nopes". (1) More than 50% of the time, your attacks (Tetris mode) will MISS (because there won't be any moves that will hit the REMAINING enemies). That's RANDOM, so it's beyond your control. (2) Your attacks (Tetris mode) are so WEAK that you could do more damage with harsh language. (3) Most of the GOOD characters are PAY WALLED, so you're left window shoppin'. UNINSTALLED!

This game lures you in and the progressively takes advantage of the player by creating an architectural lottery system. Progressively, in that the longer you play, the worse your odds get to move up in the game. The puzzles are fixed, you actually have no control over what tiles drop and they "magically" go you way once in a while. The programmers are just sad, they can't hide the bias in the game and assume you're stupid. Save your time and money for Clash of Clans.

This game started out as a very fun, interesting combination of a war game, mixed with puzzles, events & even creative match 3 battles. It is very much one-of-a-kind and can be addicting. I have been playing for 2 years, now. It has flaws like any other game but here recently, the developers have become extremely money hungry. If they could make the weapons more readily available to people and do away with the recent upgrade they might not lose half of their faithful fan base.

It's a terrible game in reality because really, there is NO GAME. You set things and wait for them to happen. Sometimes it takes DAYS or WEEKS. There is a puzzle battle mode, but it's senseless and terrible. While you wait for colored gems to line up, the enemies do whatever they want to you, and you get destroyed in 1 or 2 hits even when you have 1000 HP. It's also constantly pushing buying things which is annoying. You're basically buying your time back from playing the game waiting for it.

I am playing for a game offer. The game feels like Mafia City, where the higher you level the more expensive resources become. The game offers little rewards for wood and steel and if you're playing as an offer you have a limited time to gather resources through the world out events, or forced to use your money to buy them. Gathering on the world map is risky as you can be attacked by other players. Getting antiserum is hard as well. The game isn't fun.

False advertisement for the game. If you're here from the ads, don't bother, it doesn't play that way. It plays like the typical games of this genre. If you're new, you will be attacked by stronger players and guilds, lose some of your stuff, rinse repeat. Boring gameplay, no puzzles, just another mobile game after money. Avoid, not for F2P what so ever.

This game is not at all what the video ad shows. Which is incredibly disappointing! Apparently that ad and this game are a "bait and switch" con. I kept playing hoping to find the part in the video ad. It doesn't exist! 🤬 As for what's actually "in the game"...well it's a walk thru, push buttons to build the requested items in a pre designed order. It offers and strongly encourages you to purchase, purchase, purchase! Don't do it. Enjoy it for what it is but don't expect any Wonderful suprises

As a multi - interface game, they only do 1 right. The military battle based style is fun, but the puzzle match up system couldn't get much worse, nor could their Customer service... they don't seem to know anything about the game and are very slow to respond. As to the puzzle match system, they have no parameters for the might difference. I was told it was based on win ratio, which I tested and that's not true. No matter how many in a row lost, the might difference is often impossible odds.

AD is very deceiving. Game is nothing like what you see on the AD. Its a MMO where its play to win. You will spend most of your time fighting, gathering and defending against others for resources and power ups. Alliance is a must to survive. Puzzle matching has little to do with the game. Just want to play the campaign, good luck. You won't be able to beat the game without better characters or leveling them up. Which takes alot of time outside of the campaign and on the map, which is tedious.

Disappointing...I was looking for the experience in the adds. Apparently it doesn't exist. I should have read the reviews first. It's simply like all other puzzle battle/hero based/war games (as far as that type of game goes, it might be fine, but its not what I'm looking for). Not sure why they feel the need to try and trick us into playing war games, instead building the game they sold me on in the videos.

I saw an ad for this, and I thought, "Wow. Something entirely new and fun. Very original." Downloaded the game and was very disappointed. It is nothing like the ad at all. Its just matching colors and battling zombies over and over. I got rid of it. If it was adventurous like the ad, would be a phenominal game. Otherwise, boring as hell.

Two stars because it was fun until you get to level 9 of the campaign and nothing you do (aside from spending money) will get you past it. By the time you get there every single thing takes multiple hours and in some cases DAYS to upgrade or research, and there just isn't anything to do any more. Extremely disappointed. Could have been a great game. At this point nothing to do but delete and find something better.

Honestly I love games like this..... but when you're getting your **** caved in by someone 15 levels higher than you, you start to rethink everything about this game in particular. Events are tailored to those who pay loads of money (don't think there's a single event that can't be won with money), the devs will literally cause chaos in a peaceful state, in order to complete certain tasks/events you need to spend more money. I've played several games like this but at least they had balance.

Read the reviews, it's mentioned often that the developers do false advertising of this game. It will be nothing like the FB advertisement you see of running from zombies while solving puzzles to escape. It's actually way much more, like building an entire city and then spending days and hours playing to upgrade. And yes, pay to play usually has the advantage by far. Not saying by not spending you can't be good. Then events, it's non stop. There's so much on this game, it's a full time job

If you want to play game shown in ad, don't try this. However if you want to build a town, fight zombies and other players in a match 3 type game, be a member of a guild and level up heroes, this is a good game. Be prepared to spend dollars, it's not all free play. But once you get past the long tutorial, it is a fun game. A work in progress.

What even is this? I downloaded it thinking it was a strategy game of sorts, then a puzzle game, then a fighting game. It started up and I didn't even get a title screen before I was thrown into a puzzle escape game. No explanation of what is happening besides dialogue for the moment. The whole game is so confusing straight from the start. I couldn't even find my profile/options. Usually to begin a game, it's nice to guide you through the basics of what you're doing, what to expect and goals

False Advertising. Much like any others have said, the gameplay is NOTHING like the ads show. It's just a standard match 3 or more with some light rpg elements. It's a shame, I would love to play the version that is being advertised. Update: based on the feedback from the developer, maybe you should add "not actual gameplay" to the ads, much like other video game developers do. I think that would go a long way to assist potential players.

Absolutely brilliantly designed money-sink. Make no mistake, if you hope to surpass others in this game it will cost you thousands of real world dollars. If you just want to pass the time with the puzzles, then it's alright, but your growth will plateau quickly and that is by design. In the competition aspect of the game you will be going up against entire alliances that have spent extremely excessive amounts of money to move ahead. But it's free to install, so see for yourself 🤷

Played for about 1 minute after the intro, giving the developers the benefit of the doubt, hoping they didn't completely LIE in the advertizing videos. Yup, the advertisements are Bullsh*t. Nothing the videos imply is fact, except for that it's a puzzle game. It's a regular old puzzle game that, when you make a match, "bullets" shoot from the top of the board and hit the PICTURES of zombies. Complete waste of time & data. If I could give it 0 stars, I would.

This game is great, but not as advertised. It states some purchases may enhance your gaming experience. NO!You will not advance without purchasing packs! It is literally impossible to get to certain levels without spending money. If you don't have money, dont get started, it is worse than Vegas on some of those in app games.I have tried to get a refund on my purchases, they only approved 26 out of 176 transactions. You do the math...

I cannot stress to those who have never played it ... How much of a designed and forced pay to play system this is. Run... find anything else. Malware would probably cost you less and be more rewarding. Whatever you do, don't be stacked suckered into the microtransactuins... the game has a contruved way to take everything you buy. There is no opting out of timed events... unless you pull out the checkbook.

A bit misleading as the puzzles are probably the smallest part of the game. One of the puzzle parts, the arena, has different "worlds" all merged into one so there's no chance of finding a fair match. Really piss poor decision there. It's also, hands down, the laggiest game I've ever played and I grew up using 56k modems. Edit: still laggy and arena is still broken months later. I put in a ticket as suggested and they basically told me to get better at the game

I was actually really surprised by how shockingly bad this game is. The commercials look pretty good. But the game has a whole bunch of added garbage that you don't see in the commercials. The puzzle sections of the game are alright. But everything else is hot, steaming garbage. And there is a ton of "Everything else". Do yourself a favor, download any regular puzzle game instead of this. They all do the same thing, but are actually fun. I'll be uninstalling right after this. Avoid.

This game is nothing like the ads you will see all over the internet. It is not an fps, it has no individual combat. It is a grinding base builder, farming, factory and ally game, where zombies and other players are your enemies. It is the same game design as state of survival but with a system of rpg turn based combat with something similar to bejeweled( that was probably the most interesting part). Igave it a chance and got to over level 10 and finally gave up. Know what you are downloading.

They have very misleading ads. It's literally Impossible to beat other players and sections within the game, unless you pay money. Your base will get attacked no matter what you do, or how much fortification you have, so honestly what's the point?? It wouldn't surprise me at all if other players are just bots, if your shield is down, they're attacking. It feels more like a chore than a game.

You know what I find soooo annoying about this game?!?! It's not that it's necessarily a "bad game". I mean I played for a bit and quickly realized it's just a money trap like most others.....but the thing that drives me insane about it is that they advertise on all these other games and what you see in the ad sucks you in. Than when you actually get to play the game you see that literally NOTHING that they showed in the ad is in the game ANYWHERE....what in the hell is the point of that?!?!?

Uhhhhh.... Where"s the cool game that is in the ads I'm constantly bombarded with that make it look so cool??? So far it's been a really crappy tutorial that took way too long and you still don't know how the game works.... And I still have yet to see anything that I saw in the ads on all the other games that I played for this thing.... Slow and boring, and I'm imagining like most other games it will turn into eventually pay to play/win. Total add deception about this game don't waste your time

(MY REVIEW WAS REMOVED) I would LOVE this game if not for the extreme lag in the puzzle mode. It makes it near impossible to pass the levels sometimes and it doesn't matter who you're using. I'm also incredibly irked that the puzzles are NOTHING like they were in the ad I got the game from, Imagine that. (GOT A RESPONSE AFTER THAT) Here's the thing DEVELOPER it's not about the game QUALITY, you straight up FALSELY ADVERTISED THE GAME!!! If you aren't addressing that, then go away. We don't care.

The game can be fun at times, but mostly frustrating. The only reason I've kept the game is because the people I've met in the game. Otherwise crafting a weapon you'll never get more than a common computer, while everyone is crafting 2-4 epic weapons in a row. Showdown you get ridiculous personal quest you couldn't complete without spending hundreds of dollars and speedups. Crafting are good but not good enough to keep the game installed and keep wasting thousands of dollars on a game.

I downloaded this game bc of the ad. Total bummer. Nothing like the ad. Decent game, if you're wanting a war role play game combined with self journeys, but I've lost interest in this type of game. I only downloaded due to the ad. If it was actually like the ad, I would've stuck around, but being forced to join an alliance and put up a shield or get no where to play by yourself, just isn't my game.

Playing this game about a month now & will be deleting after this review. The fact that you need to RESEARCH how to figure out this game is ridiculous...I want to play a game, not learn how to be a rocket scientist. Besides that the fact that players 10x plus attack your sanctuary depleting you of all your resources when you are just trying to start out was enough for me to call it quits. WHY am I building a wall & making traps when they are useless?? OH!! To buy that fix you up bundle!!

Extremely poor customer service. If you ever run into a game error and open a ticket, they will usually do nothing for. When they do something, it's in the form of some compensation which never comes close to what you would have, or should have, received had there not been an error in game. With every exchange, they tell you that you should rate them 5 stars so they will provide you with better support. I have been through numerous issues and have had maybe only one positive experience.

I give 3*, for one, because the game freezes and crashes a lot - like twice an hour. For another, the Hero Stars power difference is dramatic. One thing that is no good is, the only way to beat this game is to have all 5* Heros, fully maxed. That takes forever, unless you want to kick out a couple of thousand dollars. Ain't nobody that dumb...or maybe they are. I'm not. The excessive and grotesque power difference destroys the superior fun of the game. Fix these, and 5* you'll have.

Another game of false advertising. It is nothing like advertised, once you do start playing you get to a point that opens you to being attacked by other players (not mentioned in game description). As per most games of this nature - people love to gang up on you while still a lower level player. You will be attacked repeatedly until there is nothing left (but you can pay money to get everything back). Money pit game!!!!

This is quite easily the worst game I've ever played. The game just holds your hand for a very annoying amount of time, not even letting you get into enjoying the game. Then theres the issue of all the high level players stealing your stuff constantly. There is no possible way to have fun playing this game, it's just a quick, low quality cash grab. And a terrible one at that. Don't even try this game, it'll do nothing but frustrate and annoy you

This wack false advertisement game, I swear the game is nothing like it is advertised. I'm really bothered that the lil bit of time I wasted downloading this I will never get back. No where in the ads do it say the gameplay shown is a "concept to explain the game in a short period of time" 1) The "concept” ad is nothing like the mediocre gameplay at all. 2) I will not continue wasting my time playing the game that is not what was advertised let alone pay my money to "upgrade the experience".

This game is EXPENSIVE and greedy. Go to the PnS Discord and you'll see. If you want to level up in a timely manner, you will be spending a lot of money. The divide between the spenders and F2P is massive. As you level up it gets much more expensive. It's like hook and bait. When you finally realize how costly it is, you've already invested $ and have made friends so it's difficult to just stop playing. Staff is very friendly, though, and CS is quick to reply. Graphics, are good, too.

This game constantly looks for ways to eke more money out of its players, more than any other I've played. it's a clunky, laggy mess, but the devs don't care about fixing any issues, and only want to change events to require more spending and making it harder for low-mid spenders. The opening tutorial is also one of the worst I've ever played. The game is mildly addicting, but it's not remotely worth the aggravation.

Everything you expect in a pay to win type game. I'm not even 24 hours in and it is obvious that to get far enough, you're going to be paying. So many different ways to spend your money and the return is modest at best, but to grind without paying would take so significantly long, it is not worth it. Shame to get too far into a game to get to that point where it's $$ or stop playing or grind into almost meaningless progress. Clearly several players pay enough to keep it afloat, but won't be me

The actual gameplay is nothing like the ads you're seeing spammed everywhere these days. Its basically a resource management game with a zombie skin on top. The game is ok, but I found a lot of bullying directed towards free to play players. The paying players are comically overpowered, and target lower/free players to steal their resources. This mechanic is built in to the game. Would not recommend.

I played the beta for several months. Don't believe the ads or company line about them "basically being drawn from existing gameplay" or whatnot, they're flatout lies. This is a bog standard idle strategy war game. They all steal from each other, the difference being the setting and minigames so if you've played one you've played them all. The minigame or distraction here is the very basic match-3 gameplay. Aggressive monetization & lacks defense options in favor of selling overpriced packs.

They just want your money.. I downloaded this game ONLY for free gems in another game. 1. The amount of notifications (IN GAME) payments options are overwhelming. The clearly just want your money. 2. The game has more focus on leveling up your home than actually playing the "bejeweled" part of the game to the point where if your heros aren't a high level you won't be passing the level. Asking for money 6 times in 1 play session.. I probably would have given them money if they didn't harass me.

This must be the most frustrating experience I ever had. When I was about to engage in the game and play the stages after the introduction chapter, guess what, there is this chat box right above the very first mission of chapter 2, and there is not a single way you can start chapter 2 because every click ends you at the chat interface. I cannot believe such mistakes actually exist in a published game. Seriously? Developers, are you kidding around?

Pay to play, if you don't purchase every hour, you're not playing. Everything takes hours to replenish & upgrade. All you can do is gather resources for hours until you can play again. In the meantime you're bored. To many bugs as well, if you purchase something you don't receive, well that's to bad, you have to be psychic and take a picture of what went wrong before it does so they can supposedly help you. Definitely not worth it. Boring & expensive.

Been playing for a little over 3 years. The game is free to play but has many aspects that are pay to play. The game has PAY TO WIN option. Some aspects are unbalanced (like getting 1 apex nanoweapon after years of playing and thousands of crafts). The microtransactions are, in my opinion, over-priced (devs occasionally alter packages, but try to charge based on diamonds in the pack). VERY IMPORTANT: there is a chance you can be attacked by player(s) and lose months/years of progress!

This game doesnt let you do anything. They dont let you play at all. Its nothing like the advertisement. Dont download, its a complete lie. Your getting a game that plays for you. Very disappointed! How they have any stars is surprising. False advertisement to the fullest. They make the game look fun where you can interact with the players and do puzzles. You have to get through a hour of a tutorial to find out its all a lie. Terrible development!! Dont waste your data or storage space.

"Puzzles & Survival"? More like "Puzzles & Screwed By Other Players". This is nothing like what is advertised; totally misleading as to what is in the game... its just a 3-match puzzle game, but with a twist that you fight other players. In the end, it just seems like a bad marriage of two game styles that have been done to death.

Edit history: 5, 1, now 3. This is a game that you would pick up if you just want something to look at for a long period of time, like if you're at work. Unless you want to commit to paying, anything you do will take an eternity. Unless one is able to understand this, it's easy to get frustrated when hitting a wall. Needs more puzzles as seen in ads, instead of Match-3 Jewels for 99% of it.

So far, it seems like a pretty fun game! I'm only giving 4 stars for now because most games like this seem great in the beginning, but after a certain point, it becomes so hard to level up and you end up having to spend an upserd amount of time gringing just to achieve anything. Which isn't a huge deal for idle games where you dont mind checking in from time to time and playing. However, I'm really bad about getting bored with games like that or even forgetting about them. Will update if needed.

On your response to review, I don't have Facebook and won't make an account. I have already sent many emails to your support website with only one response,"what game are you referring to and do you use android". It's already been more than 24 hours. See, I've been playing 20+ with no issues until your latest update so for the past 2 days I can't play. You don't get to blame my device and their apps for your inability to fix your game. Everything is up to date literally 1st thing I checked.

Game play does not reflect any advertising, boring combat gaming loop, and this is from someone who liked Puzzle Quest. There's also a pat 2 win kingdom vs kingdom side and pay 2 not wait base building part, with few and uninteresting characters used in combat... and terrible voice overs for what little story there is. HARD PASS. If you are going to play a game that you want to spend money on, get one that gives you more than smaller timers or temp invulnerability from predators in PvP.

Game stuff in the mall is ridiculously overpriced. I feel we hardly see a difference after spending 100's of dollars, especially 1 k just for heroe skin is crazy. I am one of the spenders, and honestly, I may have to stop playing all together. Pns makes it difficult to grow, and I understand it's a money-making business, but think about your players, we need a break from all that spending. Also the high price of things caused alot of players to quit.

This game is fun, but the only issue I have is that the pictures of gameplay do not match the game, although the description is correct. I haven't had any annoying ads, but eventually, you will have to pay to play, which is to be expected. I almost gave 4 stars because I enjoy playing, but knowing I'll have to quit unless I pay is frustrating and being misled by wrong images was another strike.

False advertisement. Game is not what the ads look like. It's also glitchy and very slow. Unless you pour money into this game your growth is very limited and unless you like sending troops out and wait to see the results there really isn't much else to this game. It's slow! The only thing this game did well is the alliance system. Players on the game are generally nice and helpful.

Strange mix of good and bad. Nothing like advertisement which is truly a disappointment. However, have been playing about a week now and have had some fun with building the world anyway. The heroes take far too long to upgrade, the jewel battles get far too difficult for the levels and there are so many buildings and extras that aren't explained properly.

I have to agree with the other reviews this game is completely misleading, misrepresenting itself, and is definitely false advertising. This isn't a game of puzzles like the ads say it is. It's another money hungry build game if I wanted to build something I would use Legos. These games really need to stop with the deceptive practices. I will definitely be filing a complaint with Google. Then after that I will be filing another complaint with FTC because the developers are running a scam on us.

The ads are annoying, and the in-app purchase items are expensive. They offer a subscription for $20/month, so I attempted to try it out. I've been charged and have yet to get subscription benefits activated. Waiting to hear back from support, but I've missed out on the event I initially purchased the subscription for. Might as well just get a refund!

Another game with false advertising. Not the game shown in it's own advertisements. Not sure who is hiring these people, but you should make the game like the ad. I felt tricked into trying this crappy game, and uninstalled just as quickly. This is a bad business practice, and maybe you should hire them to not only make your ad, but make the whole game. Their version is better and seemingly playable. But I'll never try it and find out after this, waste of time. Thanks

Got past the twotourreal, (honestly don't know how to spell that?), And I can't even get a name set. Keeps saying they were already taken. I don't have all day to think up a name. And I'm not gonna use numbers. Plus the graphics are really poor. It looked bad before I downloaded it, but after 50 adverts for this game I decided to give it a try.

Okay so this game is a scam. Saw an ad on Instagram, and I clicked the link to go to the store page, AND ITS A COMPLETEY DIFFERENT GAME. It's absolutely nothing like what the ad shows. Any game that doesn't have many screenshots of actual gameplay should not be trusted at all. Not even gonna mention all the people who have been cheated or just straight up robbed of their time and money. Don't download the game, or any other made by this studio. This just makes me sad.

The game is nothing like the ad, I would absolutely love to play a survival game where you actually have to survive by solving puzzles as you come across new obstacles. Just make it that people have to restart every time they die, so you have more encouragement to Ace those puzzles. I was hoping for different choices and storylines that you could unlock but it's not like that at all. It's just another bejeweled featuring zombies.

Utter garbage. False advertising at its worst! Ads showed a puzzle game, which looked simple, cute & fun to play! And after seeing it for MONTHS! I Finally decided to give the Game a try & downloaded it! Just to find that the Gameplay shown IN the Ads have little to nothing to do with the actual Games Gameplay! What a filthy advertising campaign I have been subjected to, for Months!! Full of lies, scams & fake promises! Avoid this Game, no matter how fun, cool & compelling the Ads make it look!

A Completely different experience than what you expect, the game is NOTHING like what the ads show. Need change your marketing pop-ups. There are many who do enjoy your format, just be honest upfront. This game is focused on building a city and an army to defend it against a huge map of other players who want to raid your resources, and kill you. Puzzles are the smallest focus of the game and you will have to auto complete previous levels tirelessly to collect an endless need for power-ups.

The game itself is great minus all the lagging, freezing up completely & no progress towards rewards in events! If that isn't enough to make you download this right now how about the custom service??? Contacted them about missing items & loss of event progress leading to lost rewards. Without addressing either issue they asked for a rating as if they had actually been of any help at all! I told them they had not addressed the issues more than once. Absolutely ridiculous and a waste of time!

False advertising. I would give 0 stars if I could. There was only 1 round of the space invaders game that was advertised and the rest is all trying to skip through the heavy plot to get to the actual game and most of the game challenges are actually gem switching games. If this game was advised that way, I wouldn't have a problem. but definitely misleading and not offering enough of what it promised. I just want to play the game I was promised, not having to skip through a bunch of dialogue.

I was sucked in by the cool ad for the game. The ad is nothing like the actual game play, false advertising. Plus the stupid "tutorial" was unnecessary. We've all played these types of games. Give an opinion to opt out. It's so annoying to be forced to play it. If you all make a game like to one you advertise. Then maybe I'll take a look. Till then this game is lame and not interesting or unique to most games pushing from other games ads. 🤣🤣🤣

Score one for false advertising. It does have you do the puzzle you see in the ads, but the gameplay is nothing like the ads. The game is one of those games where you build a base and fight others. I've played other games like that and unless you have a large amount of real money to sink into a game like this, you will be bullied and attacked by people higher in level than you trying to force you to join their faction or else. You will not be able to build and grow. Do not download this game.

It's a "kingdom" building game with a a zombie theme wallpapered over it. It's awful. Everything about the game is designed to hinder your gameplay u less you pay real money. Want to ay the campaign and do the matching mini game? Requires energy, pay $5. Want to amass an army to stand against other players? Require more resources, pay $15. Want to participate in the current events and earn any rewards? Require special, one-time use resources, pay $25.

The game is okay. A decent puzzle matching system, but there's a multiplayer element to it all that you can't really ignore, which involves building a base, troops, and forming alliances. Regualr events also take place, as well as special events that happen occasionally, but it's all dragged down by a design to push you to go for microtransaction boosts, especially the special events, which, you can't even earn 1/3 of the prizes without having to spend cash, possibly a few hundred to get it all

When I first started playing this game there were very few issues. Now almost 2 yrs later there is constantly something wrong. Half the time the game will not load, even when on wifi. Before I never had to be on wifi. Get ready to spend money, otherwise you will have basic hq and grow very slowly. Those that spend $$$$ rule the game. Considering deleting game after 2 yrs of play

Looks nothing like the commercial (admittedly typical) but it's important because the gameplay clip implies nonlinear levels where decisions matter. That doesn't exist here. Instead, it's an awkward mashup of RTS style base building and scripted forward-facing RPG battles, but instead of menus, you have puzzles. Why puzzles? It's a great question. The "Connect 3" archetype is trendy right now, but PNS suffers for it. Take out the puzzles, make it an RPG, and give the doctor real clothes.

I'm torn on this game. It's a really weird mash up of two genres that don't really work together... A town building war game and a match 3 game, both of which have dozens of options out there. I like that they're adding substance to a match 3 to give you incentive to keep playing it, but the sheer volume of them you're required to do gets annoying, especially in pvp where you're facing people who have spent years upgrading their fighters (or paid a lot of money to do so). :-/

Game is not as it was portrait on YouTube commercial videos. I wanted to play the level where you escape from a prison solving a puzzle but is nothing like it. The game is just a mixed of real time strategy with some role playing game theme, solving puzzles for attacks damages. Wonders why the game has high reviews when most reviews are low. Feels the game is falsely advertising its features.

START AWAY FROM THIS GAME. All their ads are false. There are absolutely NO puzzles in this game. And there are no character interactions or story apart from the intro which is designed to just get you hooked on paying money to advance and build up your base and army. It is a 100% pay to win game. And then when you WIN, in most win situations, you have to pay AGAIN to get your rewards. There is also a lot of Pay for a CHANCE to maybe win a reward. STAY AWAY FROM THIS GAME (the graphics suck too)

It's a basic puzzle money grabbing game. I started playing it when my favorite streamer was promoting it, but then they disbanded our Alliance. I tried to keep playing, but I kept getting attacked by other players. I really can't stand games that allow this garbage. I am getting rid of it since I can't play the game in peace w/o having my base bombarded unless I buy shields constantly. PS: My account has since been deleted. Now, I only see ads wanting me back. Please leave me alone. No more.

The matching mix with a build and conquer concept works well. The game can be played as free to play with no need to spend. However there is a huge incentive to spend on the game to do so. Ads are thankfully non existent. And it is possible to join an alliance and make some really good online friend. That said the reason for my 2* is the game is glitched with constant drops has made it unplayable. It seems if you have a sanctuary in more then 1 state on the same device. It becomes unplayable

game starts out fun, but you quickly realize around level 25 or so that you're either spending a ton of money for resources or spending months gathering resources. Becomes nothing more than a farm game. Also, there are exploits that need addressing like events that give you same rewards for hunting low level lairs (which takes less resources) as you would running a high level lair (using more resources for same amount of reward). Game also has other issues like arena where you're not pitted against equal tiered heroes, but ones much higher than your level that you can't even begin to fight. Overall, this game is a cash grab that becomes less fun the more you progress. Interesting idea, but frustrating and increasingly boring the further you get into the game. And expensive.

This game is just like every other free app game it seems. Just an endless time waster and money pit if you actually spend money on these. Additionally, the adds that lead you to this game are nothing like the actual game. Just another cheap remake of the same basic game structure as many others, with a zombie theme. It's just another money grab.

After 4.5 months, I would not recommend playing the game at all. Aside from being too time consuming, there is no way to dismiss the weekly promo screen, so you see it EVERY time you log in (which can get annoying fast along with lag for those of you who have multiple accounts). Also, I have not seen the scenes from the video ads in the game, & I thought I would see those scenes by now with all the $$$ people spend on the game.

I’m very disappointed. The liquid sorting mini-game in Puzzles & Survival is unfair. Level 6 cannot be completed without buying an extra tube — I even checked it with an online solver, which confirmed there’s no possible solution. I sent screenshots and proof to support, but they ignored them and kept sending generic replies. I can’t say for sure, but I’m quite sure other mini-games are designed the same way — to make players pay instead of play. It feels dishonest and ruins the fun.

Please note that none of the scenes from the advertisement appear in this game. It seems like the bare minimum of effort went into making this game. They decided the strong points were to have a lot of sexy women, flashy lights, and gunfire. The voice acting is flat. The animation is stale. The story is forgettable. And on top of all this they're just using a game engine that five other games use. They just replaced swords and magic with rifles and grenades.

Tutorial is WAY too long, there is a lot of "features" that intertwine in an inconvenient methodical sort of way. Looking at the game store all of the purchase items is like looking at a legal crime. With all of their ads it makes sense of why. The only reason someone could continue to play the game is that the player has a fetish for losing money, time and respect for one's self.

The game is reasonably easy to play and has a large following. The alliance members are excellent for the most part and diverse from around the world. With that said...It has become loaded with internal ads to annoy you over the years to get you to spend money in place of patience. This app has turned into a Battle Royale of the biggest spenders. It is for this reason that after having played this game for years I have decided to QUIT COMPLETELY.

After having to reload the game and download the 39MB update twice, the game still kept starting over. There is no way to turn off the idiotic "help" mode that tells you how to play and I had to repeat the first level 3 times to complete it, then it frozale and started over again. This may as well have been designed by Microsoft. Worst puzzle game experience ever. Do not get.

Unfortunately was hoping for something similar to the ads. The game knows that's what players want, because the first tutorial is full of Real-Time event like battles and then a match-3 full battle vs a boss. That ends after 5 minutes and the game just turns into every single other base building, kill enemies on a map, fight other bases for resources, upgrade for hours and hours, idle-games. The only decent part of the game is the campaign, but again it's just match-3 puzzle. Uninstalled.

All of the strategy build research gather games are easy at the begging, it's to drawl you. In. They have players that they place in the game and support them financially to try to get others players to spend money. Do not be drawn into this tactic. If you want to do really good you will have to pay obscene amounts of money for anything that would be of contention.

I really liked the game but decided to uninstall it because the PVP aspect is just so annoying. If there was an option to turn it off the game would be perfect. If you don't play alot and keep a force field up around your sanctuary, you constantly get attacked, especially as you level and advance. It's pretty hard to keep one if you don't spend real money too. Also, can't do a lot of events without other alliance members. Would love to play again if the pvp and alliance stuff is ever changed.

Let's get the HORRIBLE out of the way here. I started playing PnS within a month of so of it's initial release and for those wondering if it's pay to win, it absolutely is!! When the game first dropped the PTW wasn't as prevalent as it is today. In the beginning you could grind it out, and have a really good shot at earning those stronger heros through events. Slowly but surely that has changed and at this point if you're not dropping a few hundred a week you're not even relevant.

Boring and not at all like the advertisements. Ok, i was done within less then 20min and didn't even finish the tutorial. Less of a match and choices game and more of a classic base building game that follows a story line. If it was advertised as that I would give it 3-4 stars. But i was anticipating a completely different style of game. The one advertised looked fun and different. Reality its stereotypical.

I've spent I think almsot a year in this game, maybe less and I loved it. It was a super fun game, the issue with is I takes money to get anywhere in this game. I literally spend days grinding on resources just to forget to sheild and have all my resources stolen from other players. You literally have to spend money or you had to be one of the first players to have any fun in this game. This game really let me down

This is not a free to play game. It is free to start, but if you continue playing you will have to spend money to progress. It also has a flawed battle mechanic that allows people to repeatedly attack you when you are not in a position to respond, say asleep or at work. This completely depletes the supplies you've earned or bought. There are no external notifications and no way to opt out. The only way to avoid that is to, surprise, spend money on shields. And spend more to replenish.

Although the advertisement here is completely incorrect and needs to be fixed, it's plenty enjoyable for what it is, a base building game with puzzle match combat and mini games. I enjoy it and I love the interaction with other players but there is A LOT of waiting when your lvl gets higher for upgrades. I have no interest in paying to play, it needs to be more fair and welcoming to players in my opinion. As long it's available for free to play I'd say it's a keeper.

Slightly laggy, along with the other complaints about the game totally not being as shown in the ads. It's almost like the mobile strike games where you have to build up your buildings and armies, but also has a match 3 concept to it as well. It's not horrible to say the least. Just disappointed because the game the app advertises looks like it would be pretty fun!

In a word: Boring. This has been done 10s of thousands of times before and better too. Same old cash grab mechanics, tired old ui, and poor translations. The ads were a lie but thats nothing new these days,the idea seemed neat but its just not. Oh, and forced tutorials on a matching game? Come on! No one needs to know how to match 3, 4, 5 etc. Your game isn't fresh, it doesn't introduce anything new or unique, and the ui is the standard affair, so your tutorial is just a waste of time.

Numerous often ads, simpleton game play, no challenge app that asks for money!!!! Seriously, I don't mind spending money on a app or game that had more to offer. Puzzle & Survival reminds me of playing.....checkers. Barely any strategy, and sometimes you may get lucky. Upgrading just becomes a chore that eventually, you spend a buck here and there at. Unless you're willing to buy the game ($$$$$$) game play stays the same and continues to adk for money. My 2 cents.

Forget the ads. Bog standard match 3 game. It does have more to do than some of the others but by the time you reach Chapter 8 in the main quest it becomes pay to win You'll never be able to recruit characters strong enough to carry on and it takes forever to assemble the resources you need to upgrade the meager ones you can get at the tavern, when you actually get one instead of a fragment or a useless item you won't be able to use because you aren't leveled up enough to use it.

0 pictures of gameplay? Shocking! If course it's not shocking at all, it's just the latest in a long tradition of games that are such boring, blatant, manipulative "free" to "play" Skinner boxes that they have to blatantly lie and advertise a completely different, fictional product that actually looks like it might be a game. Because, of course, absolutely no one would have interest if they showed what this game actually was...

The game starts out fun, but no need to try it if you don't want to drop tons of money. The game is a money grab and if you don't want to pay to play you can't compete. There are price ranges from .99 not to bad to $100. If you like special skins looking at spending $600, then other upgrades are hundreds upon that. It's not a game a normal working person can afford and be competitive. This is not an exaggeration, and if you down load and look at prices in shop you will spend to compete

I have been playing for over a year. Reeled in by false advertising, of course, but stayed because of the interaction with real people all over the world. They are my friends. That being said, I have spent over $15,000 on this game this year, and I am not a strong player, not by a long shot. The recent game changes have only increased pricing. Events have little reward for the amount you lose in battle. Only download if you like being gaslit by customer service. Wouldn't recommend it.

Okay, so the ad for the game is misleading. The one true aspect of the game is building your domain in this post apocalyptic builder. It is actually very similar to SOS and Doomsday, but with a unique twist. During campaign battles, a three-matching tile game helps your team defeat the zombies. It is the event I enjoy, don't get me wrong upgrading your buildings, training soldiers, field exploring and an occasional arena battle are good too. If you like expanding games, then I recommend it.

I have been playing this game since it's Early Access. I enjoyed it at the beginning but then they started trying to be like all the other apps due to their false advertising and it got worse. The alliances are the best part of the game and I got lucky to have an amazing one. I also hate the fact your sanctuary stays active in the game even if you uninstall, which I feel like isn't fair. Especially since your sanctuary disappears after your wall defense hits 0. Entertaining but disappointed.

After a year of play I decided that I no longer wanted to keep my account. I wasn't playing much and generally didn't like it anymore based on the player to player violence. CS was not willing to delete the account, then told me I would need to verify my identity multiple times, provide receipts for in game purchases, provide the start date, confirm the binding account info, and on and on...... I'm not sure why it's such a process to delete the account but needless to say, I just deleted app

Absolute joke of a game. Not only is this a cheap rip off of every other city builder that has existed the puzzle has NOTHING to do with puzzles. They pretend to present it in puzzle form.But if the game wants you to lose , there is literally nothing you can do. The characters I have are twenty levels above The enemy i'm fighting and are killing me in three moves. That's absurd And an INSANE inbalance in the game. Don't waste time or money.

I dont understand how there is no consequence for the way these ads lie about what the game is. Straight false advertising. The ads are NOTHING like the actual game. You're not a character running around and getting out of situations with the puzzle sequence. It's literally just one of those Dragon puzzle RPG clicky games. If you're wanting to play because of the ads, dont.

No. Just no. First off, not only is it nothing like the rage-inducing ad campaign, it is somehow worse. The female characters are only there for sex appeal and have no personality. The gameplay is bad, it's another match-3 game, which is harmless, but it's also a base building game, which is very frustrating. The art is okay in cutscenes but the rest looks like a bad 90s tycoon. The only thing I even liked about it was the godawful voice acting, and that's still a downside, but one I find funny.

It's not a game about zombie survival, nor is it a swipe and leveler like lots of other games shown with the pictures of the so called "gameplay" it is infact a color matcher (huge blunder and false advertising), not even a good one, just a bare bones matcher with some "quirky" attributes that just suck, it also would not let me get past the totorial. All I want to play is a good game for once.

This game is nothing but a waste of time,all it's designed to do is to separate you from your money,as you get higher in the game it takes forever to build anything unless you spend money on diamonds and speed ups, I'm currently trying to build up my headquarters to level 18 and it's going to take me 3 days to build unless I buy spend ups,and as far as your clan goes what a waste, I've wasted enough money on this game not spending anymore in fact I'm deleting this game.WHAT A WASTE

Its kinda boring. Tutorials continuously forcing me to do stuff even after Ive been playing for hours already and know how to play it. Never did do any puzzles. Never saw a place to do puzzles either so idk when or if there's actual puzzles or not. If there are, you have to play for several hours to get to them and that shouldnt be the case for a game with the word "puzzles" in the title. The closest thing to a puzzle I encountered were the few match 3 games just like candy crush.

Its okay. It's not so much that you have to spend money to do well. But you have to keep spending money to keep up... Was hoping for a puzzle game with a zombie theme or something like that. It is at first, but then becomes a pvp with unbalanced mechanics. A lvl 18 attacked my lvl 12 base 6 times in a row, took all my resources, and left me with a 40hr+ rebuild time before I can recover just my troops. 1 out of 10. Would not recommend unless you have money to repeatedly dump into a mobile game.

It's a good game but it crashes too much for me. That pretty much ruins the experience when your doing anything like chatting, rallying, or upgrading. Noah's Tavern needs to be changed. Instead of the 2-3, 2-4, and 3-5 hero buttons, they should make it 2-3, 3-4, and 4-5. This way you're not getting the same hero shards over and over again or getting robbed when there's an event where you use your tokens to get heros and you come up short (Unnecessarily)

There are many Zombie Apocalypse games in the market, and I've played about three of those. This game, however, is top notch as it combines my favorite genres: puzzles and strategy. The game is well-organized and developed, and the interface is smooth and intuitive. I really enjoy using puzzles to fight zombies. I don't care a whole about part of a team if every member is not contributing. I like the artwork, as it doesn't seem cluttered and overwhelming. Really good game, overall.

It's a bit boring and irritating. Puzzles are simple and take forever for a move to register. Irritating how it's just like every other MMO; iow if you're new, you won't stand a chance of enjoying this for long as you will be bombarded by other players into Oblivion just because you're weak and they have no limit on how many times you can be attacked. If you're not willing to sink a lot of money immediately, you'll never get far.

Not a fan. Clearly I'm not the demographic for this game. The tutorial cannot be skipped. The game mirrors other puzzle games I play. The RE characters are just plugged in. Wish they would have used their own characters and story that was unique. Anyway, gave this up when I saw all the city stuff that would require busy work instead of puzzles. If you like games lacking original content, love to read, make choices that are overriden, and has busy work embedded then install this game.

Love the game. Hate that everything is WAY WAY WAY overpriced. Thr creators of this game don't understand thry would make more selling 20x $.99 packs than 1x $9.99 pack. Smh. Bring down the price of rss and common items -- leave heros and specialty items at higher prices -- items that give competitive edge. You can't advance after HQ 15 unless you spend BIG $$. 5star for game play. 1 star for cost. I have heard from players based in Asia that it's only 10% of cost as in US to buy same items.

I was worried, when the 1st time I downloaded this app, and started liking it... I wondered 🤔💭 if binding the account was the way to go. But seeing I'd lose my progress, I chose not to. After all my cleaning apps weren't doing anything to my progress... Until a month later, when I lost my progress (old account) I was a little panicked. Though I kept calm and decided to try the support of "37Games", and I wasn't disappointed. The process was a bit lengthy but I got my account back.

The ads they show don't exist in the game. Though it's challenging to beat monsters in the events. The unfair thing on this game is that if you're lower level, you always get attacked and crushed by a higher level of alliances. And if you want your team heroes stronger, you need to buy stuff. The higher the level you go, the harder it is to build your camp like other games if you don't want to wait or want it faster. You need to buy a lot to make it easier and stronger to achieve high rank.

Run Away! This used to be a fun, challenging, competitive game that was enjoyable for everyone. Now you can't make much progress unless you're spending at least $500 a month. Every single thing costs money and now items in each event after the next is more and more out of reach. Our growth is cut down by two thirds (yes way more than half) from recent updates and the game has grown stale. No longer strives for player satisfaction and now just another cash grab game. All the fun and joy destroyed

Played game for a bit. Stocked up as much as possible. Due to work schedule, had to take a few days off of game. When I got back on, found out another player, more than twice my level, attacked and took everything I had worked for. Not fair someone at such a higher level was able to attack such a lower level. Uninstalled.

The game crashes to much. Constantly cutting out during battle. Want load at properly is getting frustrating and I don't know if I will continue playing if problems are not corrected. I just made a purchase from the shops and all my purchase was not included. I was supposed to get 5 100k antiserum that are missing you need to make it good.

I get that gaming coding people are some of the most abused tech workers. I get that they, too, need to make money! However, this game comes to a grinding stop if you don't keep buying package after package! To actually remain relevant & be able to play and keep up even $20 per day not enough esp after you get to level 10! I deleted the app. Thanks but no thanks. Too $$$ for a game.

Pretty sorry!!! They allow people of the same alliance that are twice '+' than your level attacke you two and three times a day. Every day!! You can't build up or even defend yourself because yours isn't strong enough.. Theses people need banded if they can't play the game right and attacke there own levels so that the smaller level players don't have to just delete the game.

False ads. Game doesn't play like the ads. It's ok how it is. But how it looked in the ad isn't this. Also, I wasted tons of good hero shards to get 1000pts so n I could aquire a level 5 hero. When I traded the points in I got a single shard for the hero. I need 10 shards to get the hero. They should make that clear. After a month and a half I'm deleting this. I was close to spending real money. I'm glad I didn't.

I was expecting it to be like the ads but was not. Developers said ad is to inspire. We have something in the USA called false advertising. Developers responded with a repetitive response that they base it on the current game, which is a lie. Also, the rating is rigged. Not all reviews are counted. I looked in for my one star review and it is not listed in the 1 stats that make up the 4.6 rating. This is rigged. I have reported this. Do not play this game if you expect what you see in the ads.

I have loved and have played this game for almost 2 years. I've met many great people thru this game. However, if you request a refund, they make you pay a ransom before you can purchase items again. I will probably be blacklisted and banned from the game, but at this point what does it matter... **Edit: I have reached out. Have gotten nothing back but bot talk that makes no sense.

Advertisments do not reflect actual gameplay honestly. What's shown in ads are the best parts of the game but also the least frequent part of it. To make things worse, they hold your hand through those parts by instructing you which moves to make and you can't go against them. This game is about building up bases and waiting for real time to pass to progress. It isn't fun and most of the game isn't advertised in their promo videos.

This predatory company values profit over humanity. If they could sell you to the zombies to eat for a few dollars they would. The micro transactions are insane. There's little skill involved in this pay to win game. Nothing is documented. Portions of the game are entirely non-functional and there's no way to tell what works. Their math is not correct and you have only vague ideas and random suggestions for how to improve. I'll never play anything like this game again.

I just wanted a simple fun game like the ads. This is an entirely different game. Is a base builder with a generic zombie story and gatcha hero collection elements with random match 3 puzzles occasionally and senselessly thrown in. Actually, base builder is very generous, there just isn't a lot of gameplay at all. There's a reason they show a completely different game in their ads Wish they just put out the game they advertised it looked way more fun (not that that's a high bar)

I've been playing for a couple of years now. I love it. Find a good alliance, ask questions, kill zombies, and win events. Good times. The art and graphics are great for a simple noble mobile game. The storyline is well done with lots of collaborations to bring in even more events and characters. Also, it updates regularly, so if there is a bug, it gets fixed

The ads made this look fun. Nothing at all like any ads. No way to skip the "tutorial" mode. It is a simple match game like any other game with "puzzles and" in the name, with a building aspect similar to Stats of Surv. Not for me but maybe for someone that likes these sort of things. EDIT: And generic response showing they don't care. Loss of star for lack of any empathy from dev.

Getting this started is easy enough, but, when you move far enough along, it quickly becomes expensive to keep yourself from being burned down by others. The hardest part is cancelling. There is no in-game function to cancel. Instead, support asks for your device details, I.P. address and game purchase history for review before they even agree to cancel your account no matter how much you ask. I am plain done with this nonsense.

The ads showed the puzzle solving, nothing about base building. The initial ads should show that. I'm not looking for another base building game. Give me a version of this game that has NOTHING BUT PUZZLES, and I'll come back. No base building, character building, just puzzles. It is obvious that they have no intention of improving the game in any meaningful way. They don't want 2 allow for finding opponents of ur level or toning down the pay-to-win aspect. They r just mining us like Bitcoin....

Definitely a pay to play. I played this for about 3 months, had a level 25. Players in my state would spend hundreds of dollars a month for supplies to get top of the troops. Low level players were attacked daily for resources. I was in the top alliance in my state. This is what we did. Unless you want to waste time and get no where, you must spend money. Beware, the best reviews are from paying players who want you to come pmay so they can take your stuff for free.

An unimpressive one of hundreds of other similar clones. It starts with a painfully terrible and long tutorial, then you're into another base builder where the main mechanic is waiting with a campaign just isn't worth it and invasion/alliance systems just like all the others. If you've played one, you've played them all. And this isn't even a good one of those. It does nothing to stand out, nothing to innovate, nothing to be worth your time.

Pay to progress otherwise you'll be doing nothing but grinding at headquarters level 10. Not fun and it gets boring and repetitive. Even the mini games require you to pay for items if you want to complete them. $3 a box by the way. Whenever you are attacked by stronger players, a level 25 player attacking a level 12, it will take 20+ hours for your troops to heal. Unless you pay 2000+ diamonds of course. Now I can't even do any of the world map stuff because the attack injured all my troops.

If you're adding this game for rewards in another, Don't! They do not pay you! This game isn't interesting to me to begin with, but I played to earn rewards. I've fought with them since day 1. They owe me quite a bit too. I can't stand companies/scams like this. It's a huge cash grab as is. The puzzles are simple, I progressed quickly, but that made it boring. On top of that, still no rewards! Next step is the rest of their social media. I don't mind saying I'm unhappy with this game company.

The game is nothing like the ads you see. After playing for a month, I can say that this game is full of events after events that are made to make you spend money. This is a building simulator where people can attack you. At first you will have a decent community, then your state opens up and endless chaos and looting ensures. Stay away from this game if you want to enjoy a good night's sleep or get down a rabbit hole of endless money drain just to stay alive.

The game overall is decent and its not a bad game to play but the advertising REALLY mislead me and the game disappointed be a huge lot as I expected the game to be more like the advertisement it said it would be like. The game seems pretty generic like many other puzzle apps but I think this one has better mechanics compared to others which I think is a great move. The advertisements from YouTube ruin the overall experience and attraction to this game and wish the game played like it's own ads.

this is my ultimate favorite zombie apocalypse game. love the puzzles and extra games. the graphics are amazing. I would have gave five stars .but at the moment I'm stuck on level 15 cannot upgrade my city hall . I close at night with supplies and wake up with none . I even gather and upgrade supplies to this becoming a epidemic. I cannot upgrade my heros. no matter what I do. completely stuck . very disappointed. so close to deleting game.

This is a pay to win kind of game. It can be fun if you find people you get along with, but there comes a point where progression is slow, those spending $1k+ take over the state/server you are playing on, and you have to pay $ to move states or invest a ton of time to earn the tickets you need to move states. Also, trying to get them to delete your account is way more challenging than the game itself.

Worst game I've ever tried. All ads are fake. There is essentially ZERO puzzle strategy involved in the real game. Whales ruin the actual game. The players are more toxic than ANY other community. I couldn't even transfer my account to another player (wasn't even selling) without getting the account banned. And when you stop playing, you will get ads forever haunting you. I wish I could give a lower rating. Ive never truly hated a game before. But I truly hate this one. DONT WASTE YOUR TIME

Was not as advertised through the game I downloaded it from. You do not hop through a building and making matches to escape, it's basically making matches to attack and advance on the zombies. I figured it would be like sim and bejeweled put together, and it's not like that, it's like the dragon advertisement where you match the colors to make attacks, and defeat the stuff @ the top of the board. Very disappointed.

I see what others mean by the ads for this game is not like the actual gameplay. For those reading this, the gameplay is good. Plays like any match 3 puzzle game where you fight enemies while building up a base. Other then that the people who made the game need to fix the ads that sponsor this game by showing real gameplay. I repeat the ads need to be fixed not the game itself.

Pretty good game except the fact it is CONSTANTLY timing out and disconnecting. I have lost many matches in the Uninvited Guests game due to it for example. It is EXTREMELY frustrating to the point I'm ready to delete the game. I have yet to find and actual customer rep to help with this issue. If not for this problem, I would continue to enjoy the game.

Sadly this is just another bait-and-switch game. It is advertised and promoted primarily as matching up blocks and defeating zombies. In reality it's another city building game where you collect resources and upgrade buildings. That's fine if that's what you're looking for. But I'm sick and tired of games pretending they're one thing so you can download them and find out their complete copies of trash bag games that already exist period extremely disappointing and deceptive.

Super disappointed! Thought it looks fun from the ad, was disappointed it wasn't at all like the actual game play...but not even truly sure what the game play is...the tutorial never went away... constantly told me where to click, no free choices at all. Then it just kept going...wasn't able to explore any of the things it was trying to tell me. Made it to what I assume would be a second phase and just uninstalled, due to never actually playing the game.

This game is so annoying, it guides you through everything and I find incredibly tedious to get through. The tutorial is way too long and could've been condensed in a way that would be less painful. The graphics are good but it's just not the game it was advertised as. I uninstalled this game almost immediately because the hand-holding aspect became too much.

Storm hit my state and now I can't log in. Half the state suffered flooding and power outage and I try to log into my game during an event when everyone is getting points for killing troops only to find I get an error saying my activity is suspicious (mind you I log in every few days as my schedule allows and play the game, how suspicious) I opened a ticket tried to check the next day. Still cannot log in and no ticket shows up. Apparently I didn't spend enough money to be important enough.

Game was fun and i found it through offerwall. But as i got towards the last couple tasks and the coins were large, all of a sudden they dont update that i qualified for the 8000+ coins. Is it tapjoy, offerwall, puzzles & survival, pocket fm? Nobody knows, its a big mystery 🤔. I know i sent in a pic of my lvl 22 headquarters, but still no coins. I spent a fair amount of money on the game too but not anymore. Ill go on and cause havoc and attack everybody until zeroed then just delete

Devs have lost a lot of players because it became too pay to play. Every mobile game has that aspect to a degree, but this one takes the title for most pay to play ever. As they have lost players they've just doubled down on the pay to play stuff. And aren't even putting forth a lot of effort in keeping the game running well. Well changed my review, they certainly did change things, so they increased how many items you need to migrate. They increased the costs across the board on many things. After the last round of updates especially, the game has become way too expensive to enjoy playing. Such a pity too, cuz playing it for 2 years now, I feel they've gone a bit too far. A NIGHTMARE. I actually really like this game; if you like RPGs & games like candy crush, it's great - gem matching meets zombie survival RPG. BUT I can't recommend it, I spent a lot of $$$ & SO much time, then the game froze, crashed & no longer works. I've a great phone, this never happens. Apparently this was a problem they had to patch last year & release notes on how to fix it. Still happened to me & no fix worked. It opens, the first screen shows, it crashes. ALL progress & ~$40 gone.

Tutorial tries to teach you EVERYTHING at once and just goes on and on. You cannot access anything else during it if say, you wanted to turn the sound off. Once you get to the "sanctuary" you've still got plenty of tutorial to get through and only then can you access settings. Then, my favorite part, you can turn off music and sfx but it is still going to play "ambiance". No option on that. Uninstalled. No thanks.

I tried this game from a rewards app. Based on the name, I thought it would be an interesting game with good variety. However, I couldn't stand playing it for more than about 10 minutes. The "puzzles" are oversimplified (a toddler could probably do them), but the progression of the story is confusing. After a couple minutes I had no idea what to click on, and after some clicking around and getting suggestions to buy things, I got stuck on a screen and couldn't do anything else.

Love the game but its impossible to keep up with the advancements without spending thousands of dollars. The latest updates are too much. There's not enough to control balance between average players and those who blow thousands of dollars.. a month! Hard to continue playing. Would like to see an option to reset your gear, chip, etc without losing anything. Just like hero resets. So we can adjust our set up without being locked into categories we already committed to. Thank you

I like the game well enough. However people are right. The ads don't match up. When I downloaded it, I saw a resident evil-esque mobile type game where you did puzzles to either escape zombies, take a serum, or attack. This is NOT that game that's advertised and you need to have that changed. You have a perfectly fine game. Advertise it as it. Also, stop with generic replies. It helps nothing. If you can't be personable then don't reply at all.

This game is decent enough, especially since it was free. However, I think it was a huge bait-and-switch since this game has absolutely NOTHING to do with the teaser videos that got me to download in the first place. The teasers portrayed you as a prisoner trying to get out of a zombie-infested prison, but the game is actually just a bunch of super soldiers trying to kill genetic freaks (through puzzle matching) in a post-apocalyptic distant future.

Not a great game. I played for a while and could comfortable rate it a 3. The experience is NOTHING like the ads presented it to be but the user interaction made it worth playing a bit longer. Now, it's a 1, possibly zero as the came has a "network error" message and i can't get in the game at all. 2 days now. No way to contact the developers, can't reinstall, nothing. I wouldn't say it's trash but for all the issues and bait & switch, I'd rather play a bubble-pop game.

A game should be fun and enticing for you to achieve goals. The end game is always the end goal. With this game, almost every event involves that you spend a lot of money in order to achieve unique items. The reward system is rigged. As an example DoomFest 3x3 tiles will never give you the nice rewards unless you expend at least $50. The lucky 7 has a low drop rate, unless you have completed 100% and for that, you again need to expend $50. The developers know and they do nothing about it.

Okay, let's be very clear here. This is NOTHING like the advertisement. Not even a little. They only got two things right from the advertisement, it is a matching game with zombies. That's it. Everything else is false advertising. Intriguing choices based on puzzles? No. Escaping a building overwhelmed by zombies? No. Getting better gear to survive situations through puzzles? No. This is a pure example of false advertising just to play another city building game. Shame on you.

It's a nice game, definitely addicting but there should be some kind of level limit for attacks. Being a level 15 and getting attacked by a level 38, you're not given any chance to survive. Also, maybe throw in some elective ads for people who can't afford to pay to play. They don't need to be pop up, but just an option. It claims gathering supplies is the best way to up your supplies, but that takes hours unless you pay for stuff to take less time.

First off, to be clear, this game is not all like any of the ads I've seen recently for it. You will *not* run away, either in 2d or 3d, from zombies, while solving puzzles to clear obstacles. It *does* involve match 3 puzzles, but most of the game is about building your city, similar to State of Survival, Evony, or the like. That said, so far, it is decent, if you're into that.

The customer support on this game is horrible, they get you to spend a bunch of money, then once you do they charge you a bunch of extra times when you buy something. If you try to reach out or mark them as fraudulent transactions they put a negative balance on your account even tho they are literally stealing money from you and not giving you items. This has happened to countless people and customer support does not help

False advertisement, game was nothing like it was in the ads. I hate games that are built around slow upgrading buildings. Like most free 2 play games it's pay to play. Edit: you want my advice, stop with the false advertisement of your game and show real gameplay. If you have to trick people into downloading your game then your clearly doing something wrong...

Every ad for this game is NOTHING like the actual game itself - the real version is far less interesting and extremely redundant. If you don't or can't spend money, they penalize you for it by making it impossible to progress or win anything significant. This is by far the absolute greediest game I've ever seen, constantly trying to get your money for every little thing. And it glitches constantly despite frequent "maintenance," so clearly they're not spending the money on fixing that.

I like the game, my only complaint is that it isn't like the ad. What is it w/ game companies creating ads that are different from the actual game? It isn't just you guys, it's almost all of them. Drives me a little crazy, lol Other than that, I had to reinstall (twice now) because I couldn't get it to load anymore. Hopefully the reinstall fixes the issue, it worked the first time but I don't want to keep doing this. I'm still playing, it's growing on me & better than others that are similar.😊

Very cool graphics not too bad overall... I like a similar game more in which you can move the puzzle piece around the board flipping around several stones along the way.... before it was runed it was good anyway... this one is pretty epic it seems but I am trying it since they promise $220 payout when I see this game is a $64 payout including $12 "rebate" then I can graduate to higher paying tasks. Level 22 HQ is the goal oh also they do mention you can quit early for less but .....?

Love this game, i have been playing it for a year now, Mostly pay to get strong. 1 star only because the adds are extremely misleading.
