Don't count on getting rewarded when you log in for 46 consecutive days. They reset it whenever they want so you don't get the better rewards. Ridiculously frustrating bugs. Impossible tasks. And PTW as per most of these Co-Op games. The Adverts are completely lying /hiding the fact you need to join /make an alliance to further the game. And if you have issues In game? Good luck ever getting anyone to resolve them.

This has to be one of the worst games I have ever played. It constantly says it lost connection even though I've got a full signal/connected to wifi where literally everything else works fine. It is irritatingly slow - you can't skip dialogue, the actual gameplay is slow and laggy. It's like they tried to combine a game with a digital graphic novel into one terribly executed app. Uninstalled.

Updated again: Probably my last update before I quit the game. Unless you want to spend a lot of money, you will get attacked by much bigger players, resulting in all your troops being killed. At that point, you have a choice to make: take 4-7 days to heal everyone (assuming that you have the resources) or pay to heal quickly. While healing, you can't do several tasks (collect resources or attack monsters/zombies, as you have no troops. It is truly all about greed. The developers could make a PvP option, so that casual players can actually play. They could also make it should that shields stack. But they won't, as they want your money and a lot of it. Good luck to new players, as you will need it. Or just save your time and don't play it. Updated review: Initially, it is an enjoyable 5-star game that isn't a major time or money waster. However, it becomes apparent after a few levels that it is all about the money. Don't get me wrong, as it costs money to develop and maintain games. However, they need to have some kind of PVP toggle switch or allow attacks on players within a few levels. Once you're over 10th level, you can get attacked. To make it worse, the game has events that specifically encourage attacks on other players. At the point, level 30+ players are slaughtering level 15 players and taking all their resources. You can shield yourself, but they don't stack (by design). So, the game offers you recovery boxes for money... just so you can get slaughtered again. At this point, I can't even collect enough resources without getting attacked and losing most of it AND having to wait 3 days for my troops to heal (unless you pay). Without troops, you can't attack or gather. Very attractive game and it is fun, but it very much is a money grab. Expect to spend $50/month at a minimum to make progress. That is more than I want to do on a mobile game.

If you don't spend money the game sucks. I've been playing the game 2 months now and not one single 5 star character. The drop rates are abysmal, and they are stingy with medals. The main story is paywalled by being so difficult you're forced to pay money or grind for HOURS or get lucky. The tiles in the main match 3 game are not random. If you stack your team with say 3 blue characters, they will put less blue tiles on the board. The game is simply not fun. Graphics are terrible too.

Like so many other games, if you think people want to play a game like the one you advertise, make that game. This is nothing like advertising. I "played" it for 10 min. Got tired of just clicking where it told me to. I already know how to match colors, dont need the help, and didnt intend on playing a building/hero collecting/upgrading/ and some matching game. However, some people probably like it. Not a fan when it offers to sell me upgrades before I finished the "how to" phase.

Like all of the other 1 star reviews, the advertisement is nothing like the game. This is just a match 3 game. Designer people, your advertisement for the game is awesome....but its not the game we get. To avoid 1 star reviews, advertise the actual game, or you will continue to get 1 star reviews. Which is what you want to avoid....correct?? Also, for your English speaking customers, you need to work on your grammar.

For some reason, whoever created this game thinks that no one has ever played a basic match three puzzle before. I hate it when a game forces me to make the selection of which gems I'm going to match. Come on, people, I've been playing games like this for so many years. After about 15 minutes of being forced to make specific selections, I uninstalled the game.

Like the other reviews, this game is not like their ads. False advertising for the type of game you'll actually be playing. The only thing the same between the game and the ads is the designs/colors of the symbols on the match pieces. There was no puzzle down the side of a building or zombies jumping out creating a stressful puzzle type game which they portray in the ads.

While it does have the puzzle elements that are featured in advertising, it is also a pvp base building game. This game style is notorious for money grabbing 'deals' for resources that can be stolen by other players. Not a game style worth investing in. I ended up playing the game via an Offerwall program for another game. It's fairly basic, and largely a clone of other empire-building browser games. Honestly, I did it for the rewards, and felt meh about it. It constantly badgers you for money, though, and even the events are cheap; I qualified for a free 5* hero, Ephraim, in the recent Path to Survival; just forgot to claim rewards. Even though I can claim the rewards, I can't get the hero. No one likes stinginess or technicalities.

I downloaded this game on recommendation from a friend and have been playing for almost two years. The game is very addictive, but over time it has become obvious the developers are money hungry. If you are not a BIG spender, you will not do well. Also, the game lags terribly during big events. This problem continues to worsen. Sure, you can create a ticket with CS but their responses are generic and never address the problem. The social element is why I continue playing.

I played this game for a bit. Leveling up can definitely be rather slow if you don't spend money. Was only on my 3rd day of gameplay when a level 42 player attacked my sanctuary when I was sleeping and wiped me out. What a waste of time this game is when you're open to attack from players of every level and all your resources can be lost in minutes. Uninstalled and will never play again.

One of the worst games ever, I spent a total of $15 on the game and I was planning on spending more but not even 24 hours on the game and I was already bombarded with attacks over 20 different times and my whole Alliance was totally zeroed. And the sad part is the game that I actually joined was actually a new state, I'm completely done with downloading apps on the App Store. State of surival zombie war is better

If you play for inbox dollars or money, don't expect fast results AT ALL . Takes years to reach achievements. Misleading ads and predatory in-app purchases. You've probably seen a ton of ads for this game. None of them have anything to do with what the game is. This game is awful. I stopped playing because I'm sick of the high level players sitting around and attacking the lower level players whenever they want. It doesn't take any skill and the developers don't care because they make lots of money from high level players who pay to advance. They also make money off people who need to recover after an attack. Everything else is just an elaborate sideshow. Don't become a hamster in their wheel, find another game to play.

This latest upgrade is bull. This was supposedly done to fulfill players' requests. I have not heard of one satisfied player. It will now be impossible to level up rare heroes without spending. Sad. I seriously doubt that is what players wanted - "Oh, please make us spend money to advance in the game" - absolute absurdity. I will stay only for the friends I have made in chat; but then again, I can converse with them via Discord, so maybe I will leave. Most expensive free game in the Play store.

Don't play this unless you have a lot of money o spend only to show up to other people. The game ask you for money every single time, every single move. Get to Headquarters level 20 and all of a sudden everything is too expensive in a way you need to wait for a month to upgrade OR PAY! Because that is what they want, also if other guilds decide to attack you, you better uninstall because it's impossible to make a comeback if you DON'T PAY. This game is a wallet drainer.

Yet another game with deceptive ads. Just make the game that you showed in the ad!!! The real game holds your hand in a death grip while "playing" the first puzzle, then wants you to build stuff and follow plans. If I wanted a base building game, I woulda downloaded one! I just wanted to match tiles to open pathways for characters to progress and escape. Why won't you let me have that?

I... have no idea how to play this game. The beginning tutorial just showed a match 3 game. simple enough I thought. But apparently different colors cause more damage? No idea which ones are good against which zombies. Can't do anything with my alliance because I'm not upgraded enough. Can't upgrade enough because I don't know which strategies are best to get materials. Gotta build a town AND do group attacks AND recruit AND upgrade... it's all too much. I want something fun, not work.

after 45 minutes I wished I had my 45 minutes back. the puzzles are boring and stop-and-go while you wait for zombies to attack. theres a zillion little blinking bits and bobs constantly trying to get you to click on them to tell you the same thing it told you 30 seconds ago. the characters have no character. it tries to do too much and doesn't do any of it well. at least I didn't get bombarded with ads every minute! thats always worth at least one star!

I downloaded the game because of the ads even though I suspected the ads were false. But after playing the game for a little while was enjoying it. But as with all of these mobile games, once you reach a certain level you have to deal with others destroying your base and you feeling like all the hours you invested in the game were wasted. I got hit by attackers three times in one week and I was done. I still keep seeing these ridiculous ads and wish I could play THAT game but doesn't exist.

As "Game of War" knock-offs go, this one is OK. Building upgrade interdependence seems to vary a bit and gets a little confusing. "Pay to win" has been replaced with "pay to play" in this iteration. I never saw any portion of the game that looks anything like the "maze" puzzle shown in the ads. I also deduct one star from every app that's affiliated with "offerwall" (or whatever their new name is) until that outfit stops screwing users over if developers fail to answer communications.

Overall not bad. The amount of free stuff you get while playing is so much better than a lot of other games out there. Two complaints tho: it takes forever to get AP & stamina, & leveling up does not replenish either. Also, please give some of the women better clothing. It's 2022, I thought we were past the oversexualization of women in games.

Left an honest review and it was taken down. This game crashes and after a certain level of progression the game will kill your team easily unless you spend useless time upgrading unnecessary buildings in this so called puzzle game. We shouldn't have to upgrade dozens of buildings in a game intended for solving puzzles. I will keep leaving my reviews even after they take this one down. People should know how others experiences are. That's the entire point of leaving a review.

Would love to give it 4 or 5 stars... but 1 - no notification support for Galaxy Note 20. Dev team aware and was told to be patient more than 2 months ago. 2 - Resources are ridiculous. The 2 most needed resources (steel & gas) are hard to gather because the resource tiles are deliberately small to force purchases. If you want to play it as an idle builder game, then this is fine. But if you want to play it as the war game it is supposed to be, be prepared to spend a LOT of money.

This isn't the game that was advertised. Pay-2-Win war game. Very little puzzle action. Too many states (servers), not enough players. You earned prizes! Pay $4.99-19.99 to unlock them. Tap an icon, wait for lag, disconnect. Notifications arrive 10-30 minutes after things happen. Too few things to do without paying. Hero duels matches you with players millions of points above you. You can fight to be ranked top 500, lose 1 match, become unranked. Nice visuals, but once you unlock everything, there is nothing to do. Not a good war game, not a good puzzle game,

Absolutely horrible, falsely advertised. Nothing like the ads represent. Like someone else reported its so laggy it isn't even fun. The game play is very out balanced and relies on large amounts of money to even have a slight chance. Even then it isn't balanced. Optimizing a game needs to make the game fair and fun not money hungry. Such a shame as it has potential but at this time save your data and space and find a different game that isn't miss leading or a total con.

Just like all the other similar titles except worse. Forced/repetitive clicks pointing to quests still being worked on. Lackluster describes this well. State of Survival is what this was trying to be, only that one is halfway decent. (OCD alert...red dot indicators that don't go away unless you use every item in your bag) Save your time and money and go with something else.

From the very beginning, this game was terrible! At first it was like a tutorial that showed you how to play and how to create special objects, but the further I got into the game, it kept choosing my moves for me and wouldn't let me actually play on my own. Plus, there was too much backstory and cut scenes, and not enough game play. Also, I'm a righty, but the controls seemed geared for a lefty. It was very awkward! Delete!

Fun but beware of the false advertising. This game has nothing in common with the adds at all except zombies. The add says "Can you get out of the prison"?? What prison?? There is no prison you are escaping from. In this game you are building a base and defending it from Zombies and other players. You collect resources, ect. The game was fun when I played it for a short time. But.. I realized that I should not support developers who falsely advertise their games so deleted it. Beware!!

It's not a half bad game, until you get far enough that a much higher level player can raid you a dozen times in a row while your troops are out gathering resources, wiping out all the progress you've made towards upgrading your buildings. ABSOLUTELY no reason to allow a player to lose 5million+ resources because they happen to be offline when they're attacked, and can't take any actions after the first raid / loss.

Kinda boring really . Another one of those false gameplay advertising deals. It seemed to me I spent more time watching the characters talk then playing the actual game got boring fast might be fun to someone that's into that kinda game. Gave it two stars because I'm really tired of these false gameplay ads. The devs have been told this over and over but they just keep doing it. Makes you not even want to go look for games anymore.

I downloaded this based off an advertisement that showed puzzles to solve. That's not at all what this game is. Like what seems like most mobile games, this is a match 3 game. Just in case you've somehow managed to avoid playing these games -and are an idiot- the developers of this one include a bunch of tutorial levels that force you to make one specific move. I got frustrated and quit without actually playing this one.

I purchased a Meyers frags pack and never received it. I opened a case and they say that I did. They are either lying or just wrong. I have spent quite a bit on this game I would not be nickel and diming a customer who was loyal. I will be starting a charge back. Stay away from this shady developer. 7/27/21-horrible support.RUN

This is a horrible game. And why does it need your location and contact information and other permissions. Very sketchy and suspicious. This game is greedy. There are constant moving or flashing indicators asking you buy items. You hit paywalls that all but demand you pay to progress. I wasn't trying to play for free, I bought some things, but the game limits you so much when you're not paying that it becomes a dull grind. Also the puzzle rng feels rigged as if there's an algo influencing gameplay for or against you in certain situations. It also crashes alot. The game is a thin layer of fun under a mountain of money grubbing.

I played this game to earn diamonds for another, and enjoyed it a bit. Once you get to the 8th story the bosses get harder to beat, and I don't fully understand how to choose your "toughest" Warriors. The game is easy to play and there's lots to do even if you run out of stamina. The only thing slowing me down is the wait times when upgrading buildings lol

Been playing since the TWD event, and I have to say the game is fun. It will keep you busy for a while. However, the in game events such as TWD or the Dinosaur Resurgence are stupidly greedy. I spent no money during TWD event and walked away with almost none of the rewards. For the Dinosaur Resurgence event I threw away over $200 to try to get the rewards and still walked away with nothing. Also everytime you boot up the game it throws an "gift" at you to buy. Game is very greedy.

So here's the thing: You spend, hundreds of thousands of dollars promoting this game with a very awesome concept - role play... escape the horde, crawl through duct, pick up power ups and get an advantage to fight zombies - oh wait puzzle! This is tricky. Gotta play it right or-- NOOOOOO! Yeah, I would have loved to play that game... instead I get a square board and pictures of zombies I attack, that don't attack back... You get a Zero star.

PTP standard. Wish the option of removing the pop up ad was permanent instead of constantly showing up every time you log in. I was able to play fine for a while until they updated to allow mods to the game. Now it won't stay open on my phone more than 10 min without crashing. Tested on both wifi and cell data to see if either made a difference. It didn't. Now I can't play with my friends. I have a Moto E

Been playing for 3 years now, moderate spender as well. The latest update has completely ruined the game. You took away our events, our rewards and have made this game for the big spenders. You've gotten extremely greedy, since Ichi & crew have left. We've been faithful to this platform, what do we get in return, NADA!! Fix it asap or you'll probably be looking for new players asap. Yes, it's free to play, but don't think you'll get anywhere without spending. So sad!

I like these types of tycoon games, but the ad was misleading. Thought this was going to be surviving zombie apocolypse choices game. But this is nothing like the ad. The only thing that was true in the ad was the puzzle's look. So it was misleading and a let down. But it looked like a cool story and mechanics and stuff, so here's 2 stars.

I wish I could give 0 stars! It only gets 1 bc most of the other players I've met are so Great! DO NOT Accept Any offer for rewards earnings for this game! This game is just a money grab! So many events constantly, EVERYTHING COSTS MONEY ALWAYS! Extremely time consuming and lately it glitches and kicks me off the game completely constantly! The shop easily tricks you into buying more than the $.99 item. I would Never, Ever play ANY games from this company/developer!

Fake ads might get you downloads, but it won't get you players. Just more of the vapid same here, only this time with a zombie skin. Basic bejeweled match 3x+ of the same color gameplay, with a barebones base building/developing, both of which will feed you that good ol' instant gratification drip for the first few hours before hitting you with a "pay us to keep progressing faster" schtick. Save your selves the trouble, this is just a game of meaningless bigger numbers and wait times.

Curiosity painfully sated. This is CRINGIEST thing I've seen in while. There's no way to turn off the tutorial to this cringefest. If you just want to play for the sake of wracking up points for gift cards, choose anything else. It's actually just as ridiculous as the previews. For all the times you've sat through an ad of this for useful items or five more moves, I will tell you up front that this is way worse than the ads you've seen. It's a dad joke dressed in Halloween discount items.

A few more interactive games could be added for the down time when you're stuck waiting for stuff to finish but overall good game. The different bank levels are kinda pointless cause you're loosing diamonds if you don't pick the 1 day return so theres no incentive for choosing the others. Could be better if you had the opportunity to have more than one deposit.

Another game with false advertising, looked like nice puzzle game, but is actually a base builder and war game using a match 3 set up to battle zombies. Very boring and repetitive. Ads show this game to be an adventure type game, but the ads are designed to lure in players by falsifying the games design with another games mechanics. Do not play

While the game is not like the advertisement as others reviewed, it is a decent game. It is a town building game where one of the enemies is zombies. You collect and level champions to fight, level your town`s buildings and yourself and, eventually can get attacked for resources by other towns. I give it 3 stars because the concept has been done before in other settings- Star Trek, medieval kingdoms, etc.

This is the most needy game I ever played. Things get ridiculously taxing and literally begs you to abandon the game. But the worst part are the actual puzzles, why would you make a game that freezes your controls so the enemy can hammer you dead? It's unfair and very annoying. Plus all this effort for vehicles and traps and troops and you never get to use them. Also the exchange shops are horrible, neediest game I have ever played. It cant be fixed sorry. UNINSTALLED!

This game is NOTHING like the game shown in the ads for it that pop up in other games. It is not a side-scroll RPG with puzzles to gain equipment or exits. It's just another wargame, building a city and an army and then fighting in wars as part of an alliance. As wargames go it's decent, but I did not download looking for a wargame, I wanted the game in the ads!

Nothing like the ads The only time it is similar to the ads is during the opening and they don't even let you make the decisions. I hadn't played in awhile and decided to open it up for another shot. After going through the downloads it told me I needed to move to a new server...it did not tell me that I would lose EVERYTHING! These games are time consuming enough, the last thing I want is to start over with nothing. Byyyeeeeee

This truly may be the most obnoxious tutorial I have ever seen, like many others have said. Boring cut scenes. and forced "learning" of a game mechanic that has been around for literally 30 years. And then when you play, more boring cut scenes. Actually, just one cut scene. Played over and over again. Absolutely no creativity was put into this game at all. Nothing to make people want to play this over the 5000 or so games just like it on mobile.

Pay to play! I have spent nearly 70.00 dollars on in app purchases in just the last few weeks. Making in app purchases are actually necessary to complete daily tasks. It just never ends! I finally cut my losses and uninstalled. I make lots of money but this is just not worth it to keep playing the game. In my opinion do not install this game! It is an endless money pit!

Horrible game, dont get sunk into it! They will take your money and laugh to the bank with it! Pay 2 win is the only way and the top usually do it to become unstoppable for entire servers. Not to mention, horrible advertisement practices which don't translate to actual game play. Guys, stay away. Good luck out there. This game, all the thumbs down.

The advertisement for the gameplay is misleading and I'm not entirely sure why the developers would do that. Besides that, the game itself is relatively decent. It's a mixture of Candy Crush and city/army building, the story/goal is simple and straight forward, and the social aspect of it is probably what I enjoy the most. If you're looking for an easy game and one that just helps pass the time, this would be a solid fit.

Downloaded game because I liked the ads, was extremely disappointed with actual gameplay. It was nothing close to the ad, ad shows more 3D, actual play is stupid do nothing but touch this building to do nothing, touch this building to upgrade, but actually do nothing. Not an active game play, more like an idle style game. VERY STUPID AND BORING!!!!!!!!! Would give 0 stars if I could.

It is nothing like the trailer. Its cand crush and building up your town. Game might be good but totally misleading for that reason 1*. Google play store shouldn't let this happen. The old bait and switch. .Again make the game in the ad. If its to much to make for a app version maybe for a console (xbox/ps5). So many people agree the game would be GREAT. YOU have a $$$ idea lets see what happens 37

False advertising. Bait and switch. The ad shows a puzzle game that is totally different from the actual game experience. Literally just a re-skin of every other C3 style game out there. There is also multi-player element that is extremely aggressive and hostile. It's only fun if you enjoy being an a-hole with a bunch of other a-holes. Don't fall for it. Skip this one.

Great game until you hit around d HQ 28... then it becomes very Pay To Win. One attack can completely wipe out your troops forcing the surviving ones to heal for 2 real life weeks... unless you pay. Research and building costs are in the millions... but don't worry the game will allow you to collect resources 14k over the course of a few hours before you have to log in to reset your gatherers. The game is incredibly fun for a few months but there is a real heavy paywall as you hit the mid 20s.

Love this game! It's more than just a match 3 puzzle game. There is something for everyone. I have gained friends from around the world. It is a war game, headquarters and troop building, variety of match 3, holiday events and regular nightly events, fight other states, build stronger characters, help your teammates get stronger and so much more! There is always something to do. My only complaint, which they have improved, is it's slow growing for F2P players. CS is very good also.

Very fun game, enjoyable and addictive. That said, the advertisements for it are very misleading, and only representative of the first five minutes of the game, before it switches to a base building survival game. Also, they constantly try to get you to make highly overpriced in-game purchases. And almost every female character is drawn to be eye candy for adolescent boys. But other than that, great game, lots of fun.

The ad's and the app cover image show a different game than the actual gameplay... the actual game play is building a base, fighting enemies by playing a "match 3" style game and attacking other bases around you like another big game out there (I won't drop game names). Disappointed in the fact that it wasn't what the ad's or the cover image portray.

Opening tutorial is absolutely unbearable. Stop hand-holding so hard. Totally ridiculous, almost hilariously absurd. When I wasn't being ordered around like a toddler by the tutorial, it was tons and tons of dialogue. You can setup the game and story without forcing people through this and most would prefer that. I downloaded a game, I want to play the game. I've already uninstalled didn't even finish the tutorial. Give option to skip and maybe I'll give it another chance.

So far the game is absolutely nothing like the advertisements I've seen except for a very lame puzzle mechanic that requires you to solve puzzles in certain areas of the puzzle or it doesn't count. Will the game ever be like the advertisements? Thats what I want to play not some lame generic build a base, pay to win game like you have me playing now. Why all the deceit?

I have been playing this game for about 4 years now, and I do agree that it has become VERY expensive to play! I enjoy getting to know the other players and we do have fun chatting and working as a team.. when the game doesnt screw up, Im always restarting my phone and hitting "fix game" that doesnt seem to work.. This is the ONLY game that I have played that messes up on a daily basis and happens at the worst times possible! Thats frustrating and takes the fun out of playing a very pricey game!

Though kind of entertaining, it's not fun being advertised to in order to increase the game experience. It kind of was a waste of time. I'd rather pay for a game filled with nonstop action/adventure or brain challenging puzzles. It is kind of diabolical these kind of games advertise as puzzles, let you play 2 or 3 puzzles then expect you to build a waring city with no chance to win without paying hundreds of dollars, like no doubt the top 10 players( no doubt the developers or thr kids

The game itself can be fun. However, once you get to a certain lvl, it frustratingly slows down to a stand still. I get what the creators is trying to do with the slow crawl, "get people to pump out cash" and that's where this game craps out. You can pump hundreds of dollars and thousands of hours of game play into this game and still be struggling to lvl your headquarter and characters to any satisfaction. Take my advice, save yourself the headache and cash, give this game a hard pass.

So it's just a "strategy" game where you move the blocks and get to do attacks but it was pretty much at the wheel the whole time I played. Not worth it. Needs improvement. And it's not entirely what I thought it was, thought it was Kinda like temple run but you go through the mazes running from zombies, no. It was Kind of like a phone version maybe of world of warcraft.

It really pisses me off that it forces you to do things. I understand it wants to show you how to play the game but at least give me an option to skip the tutorial and at some point the tutorial has to stop. I've been play for over 30 minutes and it's still pointing at stuff and I can't click on anything else but what it wants me to do. Really annoying. Already annoyed it isn't just a puzzle game like empires and puzzles but a mix of that game and zombie survival.

While it has been pretty f2p friendly. I still Hate how in your face they are about the microtransactions. I do not wish to spend money on the game stop making me have to close out things when I open it. For once I'd like to see a mobile game that can be fun & not have every corner saying "here's this thing you can buy" it makes me wanna delete the app. Its to kill time.

Was having an awesome time playing the game. Got my headquarters to level 11, and the game restarted like I had never played at all! Now, it doesn't allow me to make ANY plays. Just forces me to make predetermined moves. What's the point! I'm so angry and waisted an entire week for nothing. I would've given an excellent rating, but now? No wonder you offered 7k SB. You blocked it so no one can get to the required level. Fraudulent offer.

So since they don't care about Amazon reviewe (currently 2 stars) I un-installed and got Amazon version for cheaper upgrades. Don't buy stuff from this. Not worth it Edit: closed my ticket stole $$

Game mixed two genres with 2 different genres. RPG with puzzle. Game play is ok. Problem is how you summon heroes is stupid. You can either get the whole hero, or not at all. You can use leftover pieces to improve but it kind of gets frustrating if you need to upgrade fast. It's a 3 star game but it gets 1 star for the really bad ads it has to promote the game

**MASSIVELY TIME CONSUMING** If you end up enjoying this game, even a little, be Aware! You will need at least an hour each time you log-in to claim daily "prizes", start a new building and research, etc... There are puzzles of the match 3 variety but this game is more strategy and player interaction.

Don't play this game they try to remove bad reviews so it makes them look good. This app is nothing like it states at all, especially in the ads. They lie to your face about it being just a puzzling game, when its not. Its a Townsville game with puzzling like aspects. As a gamer, who's got 5 consoles, I can say this is not even worth touching or putting effort into. This game is all about paying to progress, can't call that free at all. The devs can remove my stuff all they want.

I love this game, having troops to manage and send on missions in addition to the campaign and leveling up heros is a lot of fun. The part that leaves a bitter taste in my mouth tho, is that you have the ability to just move your sanctuary. It's actually cancer, super high lvl players will teleport on top of me, ransack my base, steal practically all of my resources, and then move somewhere else before i could even think about attacking them again.

The game is not like the ad. The beginning of the game is a tutorial that takes too long. All responses from developers are canned and it seems that they could care less about your experience. On the positive side, if you like the type of game that this actually is, it could be fun. I have played far too many of these games to find it interesting. I don't like spending $$$ on games that use it on advertisements that are misleading.

nothing like the preview video or the ads. no match 3 to escape or anything. nothing in the game resembles the ads. just a basic kingdom builder with MMO. so annoying when the preview video or ad is a complete fabrication. I want to play ~that~ game, not this one. ::: update: reinstalled after a year and it's all still the same. a fake ad for a game that doesn't exist. zero stars. I want the time back that I wasted on this game. ::: reply to dev: if it's not in the game, Don't put it in the ad.

The ads for the game are extremely misleading because it's not anything like the actual game. I wish it was because the ads look way more fun than the actual gameplay. There's so many city building war games already and they get old after awhile and you have to pay to get far so to think we were getting something similar to the ad was exciting, until it wasn't what you made it seem. You should change the ads to match the actual game because it's false advertising.

I had to change my review. So this is actually a fun game BUT! the whole time I played I missed out on certain events due to not being a high enough lvl or not having certain things unlocked. Also the more I played the more I realized you are always chasing but just outta reach of the good prizes. I spent some$ still chasing! The non payers have a small chance to get anything awesome. Game makers never throw them a bone! Tip game makers: in a mobile world you can't dangle the carrot forever!

Played this every day for nearly 2 years. Never missed a login. What has taken place with money grabs by this company in the past couple of months should be simply embarrassing. From making it $20 to get the same rewards that were free for 4 years to the latest which happened last 2 days ago... having a program error which gave out more rewards than they intended. Instead of just allowing it, they grinched the rewards but certainly kept money they received. I'm officially done. You ruined it.

This game has features you can expect of a freemium, like events that can't be won unless you pay. But it also has features you shouldn't expect, like insider trading (discounted items placed on their market store and then suddenly disappearing) or unexpected dropping of shields (turning you into instant food for big players).

The game is just like all other survival mobile game with the exception that you use a puzzle for attacks. Now I have three stars because you as a player are wasting puzzle moves yet getting combos for air attacks. As a long time mmo and pvp player, mobile games should be more unique and not implement The Joker every mobile survival game. If a solo version for the puzzles I would play but really Joker.

Was great for over a year and two days ago it stopped loading, got it to load and can't do anything, finally got to some menu and the only options that work are the options that leave the game. Complete bait and switch, this game is absolutely nothing like the ads. Think its a trend now to do ads that promise one thing but give you another. Played it for a few to see if I could except (guess that's what the developers are hoping for) but deleted it after an hour. Edit: To the developer, the simplest way to avoid the majority of the negative comments is to simply advertise the game as is. The fact that the ads persist after all the comments just means it's on purpose.

The Play store should force the developers to put a disclaimer on their billions of ads they force down your throat. The ads do not come remotely close to displaying the actual game play. The game itself is kind of entertaining, but it's a massive grind fest and loses its charm very quickly. Add in the fact that, through three days of play, it looks as though over 60% of the game is paywalled. Try again, devs.

First, I saw an ad for this game on another game. When I downloaded the game, it has a completely different name than it was listed as on the ad. 2nd it starts as a jewel matching game, which isn't shown in the ad at all, then it moves in to a story based game that you have to read everything and can't skip ahead. I gave it 5 minutes of being annoyed then deleted it

This game is a lot better than a lot of the ones that use this same platform. There are good side quests to do, including puzzles in the mix is a nice touch, and building progresses better than some games like this. Being attacked is also not as severe a problem as many of these games. It's still a pay to win game that includes constant sheilding in it's formula and it's pretty much impossible to play without being part of an alliance, and those are some pretty big strikes.

Good game until I tried to see what creating a new character in another state would do. BIG MISTAKE. It makes you go through the full tutorial all over again and you cannot stop it to just go back to main. I am not sitting there through all that again. The tutorial is the longest I have EVER seen in a game. I know how to play gem games. It should know you already have a character and just let you play the new one. Not sure I'll play anymore.

Gameplay is not like it shows in all the commercials which is super frustrating. Decently fun match 3 game overall, but the amount of work needed to make any real progress is insane. Totally pay to win, to a ridiculous degree. Game play gets stale after a while too. If the game play was like they show on the ads, it'd be a different story.

the only reason why I got this game was because it had Transformers on it. I finally got to get bumblebee on this promotional event. the app updated things are glitchy. you can't even defeat a low zombie lair level without having more than two other players when it less complicated. sometimes you get rewards for donating sometimes you don't. I've on this game for the past 79 days multiple times daily. there is no real person to respond to the questions asked in the help option, just a beta.

It's the same thing in a different wrapper. Same as state of survival, evony, ants, game of war, etc. Build stuff, wait..., upgrade that stuff, wait..., train soldiers, wait..., harvest resources, wait..., wash rinse and repeat, then join an alliance. *yawn* There are puzzles (jewel matching) but it's limited by daily energy and upgrading characters. I find these games boring and mostly geared toward profit and less toward enjoyment.

Why do you guys false advertise to get people to download and play your game? It's no different than empires and puzzlee. But the ad for it suggests otherwise. All you're doing, is making people delete the game after downloading and playing it once. I believe that's what you all care about. As long as people will download it and play it just that once. It probably counts towards how much money goes in your pocket. You dont care about the gamer/player. That's just awful. Uh uh uh...

I used to play this game daily. Trust me when I say ALL of their ads are bait and switch! It IS PAY TO WIN. Match 3 is about 25% of game play. The rest is about building a base. Getting heroes. And CONSTANT UPGRADING. It is an alliance based game. If you have HOURS of free time. Hundreds of extra dollars. You might have fun. Just know you will be going up against players that literally spend THOUSANDS of dollars per month. No, that's not an exaggeration. #2 top earnings for a reason.

I wish the game was more like the ads. That's what hooked me. It's not like it, it's building, training, managing with the puzzles only used for combat. That's not what I got hooked on, I wanted active movement with puzzle choices. Ads make me mad when stupid choice is made. Made me want to do it right. Then gave me something else. It's okay, but not what I wanted.

Adjusted rating based on ridiculously deceptive ads. Show the game, people, not garbage videos. The game has a lot to do, and it's challenging. The worst part is it's pay to win, and there's a whale problem. I've been playing for a month, and i think I'm moderately competitive. The whales will steamroll over the little guys with no compunction and no recourse. It's ridiculous. I wish there were a way to just mark yourself as peaceful and stay out of the PvP. Or have non-PvP servers.

Pay to win game. It constantly reminds you to buy packs and rewards you for doing so. If you're not waiting, the game has crashed (bad servers in China) and you're set with other glitches too. They also made ant legion. It plays exactly the same with the same rewards and choices. Don't buy anything in either. They were just too lazy to try anything new. I already contacted and submitted a ticket, but they had no response. As stated, there is nothing new.

Used to be a good game. But the game staff made the game inferior with all the additional features instead of sticking to what already was working. I gave up my castles that I dumped a lot of money into because it is not worth playing anymore. Most players do not want to fight or war. I used to blame the players for not being War Game players but honestly cannot blame them because for 1 The Game gives you & your team way too much to do it is more a Task Game than War Game.

I'll start by saying, this game is really fun. Love the social aspect, regular events and updates. The gameplay is mostly smooth, very straight forward. Looks nothing like the ads, of course. Now, onto the bad. This is a heavy heavy pay to win game. Free to play games can't compete with pay to win whales. Unfortunately, this is how mobile games are. Drama in this game is going to happen as well, to the point I've seen a kid doxxed and stalked. Do I suggest this game? No. Even though I love it.

Great game, HORRIBLE operating system!! The game is fun to play, just know that for every 15mins you play it, the game with crash 5-7 times!! This happens EVERY day, 3-4 times a 15mins when I am playing. It is extremely frustrating, but there is nothing I can do, so I just restart it 15-21 times a day!! The company DOES NOT CARE about the issue, only about the money you spend, & unless you have A LOT OF MONEY to spend, DO NOT GET this game!! **BS Response** 4-5 bars of 5G, not the connection**

The only reason I played this game is to get premium currency in another game for free. The reason I'm giving this one star is because I was attacked 33 times in a row by the same guy while offline with no warning. This should not be a thing. Other games with a similar PVP mechanic give attacked players a 24hr shield so they don't get drained of every resource they have gained up to that point. To be blunt, if the game was in any way fun or at least fair, I might have kept it but now I will not.

Game doesn't work loads to 55% then says it can't connect to network. Then when it finally does you go back to dead troops, stolen resources, no chance of completing events since the time lapse from the game stopping midway into playing to when it decides to let you in is far too long and it's just pointless at this point.

I downloaded this game to enjoy the Resident elEvil cross-over events. I do like the game, the puzzle gameplay reminds me of the gameplay of the Stranger Things puzzle game which I enjoy a lot! The building stuff is ok I guess? Interacting with other players is fun! I'm not sure why but I'm unable to do the Resident Evil quests. I click on it and it leads me no where. I'm also at the required level needed to do it. Other players I've talked to are having a similar problem.

The gimmick is not worth the grind. And most of the ads are lies but you DO actually get to play what is basically bejeweled. This is just a typical base builder with some really greedy mechanics for this type of game. Hope you aren't the impatient whale they are looking for otherwise you'll be waiting around a lot. And when you get to play it's not for long before you are waiting around again.

Annoying dialog. For a puzzle game, it does not need so much pop ups. Plus, it tends to want to tell you how to play. if you don't click on what it wants you to click on you can't do anything else. What's the point of playing if I can't figure out for myself at lease some parts of the game. That just took the fun out of it, got bored, and deleted it.

Gaming is okay if you have a good crew to play with. Takes lots of time to build if you don't have money. The worst is the Support team. I proved several ways I met all my log in days and they still denied me. Including the fact my mini account on the SAME app never lost any days and I log into that one last through the big one that lost the days. Anything you report that doesn't have a ton of people having the same issue is deemed not their fault by their people. Support does nothing to help.

The very beginning/opening of the game is exactly as advertised! Solve matching puzzles to get weapons and armour. After that, it's a never end world of building towns that you don't remotely care about and women characters dressed in stupid outfits, aimed to turn on anyone with a 15yo mentality, that would get them killed. If the game STAYED AS ADVERTISED it'd be phenomenal. But instead you're stuck in a repetitive cycle of meaningless upgrades and character recruitment.

I had no problem down loading the game, started play defending my team through the initial maze. There were several challenges to defeat to successfully complete the first level. The game froze after that! And I'm trying to restart it without losing my defeat! Very frustrating, good game, but just don't know if a recommendation would be fair at this point.

This game is way too busy. Too many things to keep track of, which can be great if done well, but this is so cluttered and clunky. The match 3 gameplay is some of the most boring I've ever played. I like building my base and expanding, but this game is way too cumbersome and unfullfulling. I keep playing because I spent some money on it, but I'm not sure how much longer. The actual gameplay of match 3 leaves so much to be desired. PvP, I think requires tactics, but I have yet to understand why.

A few top players makes the fields uneven. About 5 top players maxed every new item and uses that power to force smaller players and states to submit. Extremely expensive to play. Very difficult to compete without spending. Customer Support provides generic responses and vague answers. Otherwise it's a war game... Not a puzzle game. Alliances and states and conquest. Developers are more interested in increasing profit than fixing bugs. Huge lag problem.

This game is so clearly aimed at teenage boys, with all the women characters half dressed and ta ta's the size of basketballs. The story line is barely cohesive and the voice acting is terrible. I didn't stick with the game long enough to find out if the actual game play is any good or not. I'm really surprised this game is this awful, I'm really enjoying their other game Trading Legends.

The puzzles are rigged. All the leaderboards are all Asian dominated. Money grab game. Pay to play. Free to play grow at a snails pace. Been playing over 2 years now and everything is geared to you spending loads of money. Don’t recommend trying it. It can suck you into the never ending pit. Find a better game that has fair gameplay.

5 STARS for the game. minus 100 for customer service. Minus 1,000 for the glitches. I love the game play and have invested time and money. BUT every few days, when I build up to a decent power level, The stupid game starts me as a brand new account and then customer service asks for so so so so much detailed information, in order to get my original account back. I submitted everything they've asked and still haven't gained access. DON'T BOTHER. You'll get addicted and then lose access.

Well I was going to download the game because of the ad but once I started reading that it's nothing like the ad I changed my mind. Moving through a prison and connecting puzzles would have been awesome. And other scenarios like that. but if the game is just stationary and never moves that stupid and you should click bait players with false ads!

The ad says you don't have to spend countless hours building cities. Nonsense. You do have to build a city and army. If you can't strictly for the puzzles ONLY seen in the ads, don't waste your time. Puzzles are in the game but you have to build as well. Ad is deceptive. Uninstalled this because of the dumb ad developer approved.

This game isn't at all what is advertised. It's a tile puzzle based game, the worst of all is that it forces you to play the tiles already selected in the game; you never really play or solve anything at all, sneaky advertising. Many games now use this boring tile based, cancel culture era bs now (I'm in Florida, I'm free to express myself).

I have played for 8 months. This game was great... but really catering to the top 1% of the game. If you want to spend 50-250k to be a top player its the game for you. If you want to spend 25-35k you can be a decent player but still not do anything... i mean to 6 star your building and research its $600.00... and thats just one small thing... but really if ready to blow 100k.. its the game for you... and you will still get beat easy...

Response to developer: I sent an email. It has taken a week of emails and I still don't have my account or my refund. Don't try to fool others into thinking you will actually do something if there is a problem. Don't spend your time or money on this game. The phone I installed this on was somehow unable to reinstall after accidentally deleting the game. Support won't do anything to retrieve the account or refund money. As long as they have your money, they don't care.

I have played this game for over 2 years and am finally about to throw in the towel. The developers made updates and as an "anniversary" gift changed several aspects that left F2P and mod. end spenders furious. The last 6 weeks have been filled with surveys, suggestions and complaints that they continue to ignore. They apparently have decided to reward loyal players by making it impossible to play without a massive CC limit. Expect a min. of $200 a week to keep up playing or you just die.

This game used to be fun and exciting to play. After the recent update, it becomes total mess. They reduce the event's reward that we can get for free by reducing the frequency of it. The good event that is loved by everyone is replaced with the new one that is more spending money oriented. Bottom line, they want us to spend money for playing this game by making free players harder to grow.

Ok so i cracked and downloaded this game. I went in knowing the ads didn't represent what the actual game was, so I wasn't expecting much. But it was much much worse than I thought. The game is filled with generic, forgettable, and copywriten adaptations of other characters. The game play was visually unappealing and jarring at best. To think there are people out there that spend money on this is more terrifying than the zombies

This game could be better. Ive played similar games that were better executed. Also this really has nothing to do with The Walking Dead. I guess is the skins you can buy of TWD characters but thats false advertising. They don't really explain anything. Half the time you don't know what you're supposed to do for events. Terrible customer service. Ive contacted twice with no response.

Like everyone of these types of games, unless you're spending, you can't do much because you'll constantly get hit & farmed by the spenders. Also even if you do spend to level up to a comfortable level where you don't become a farm for the big spenders... As soon as you stop putting money into the game, they throttle your account so that you'll spend again. I've been losing to players much weaker than me in the various events they have in the game. It's ridiculous.My power doesn't match my stats

I have been noticing pushed updates not from Google play, but the game itself happening, and for whatever reason the last one broke the game. It won't load, and there is what's seems like a loading loop. I tried the fix game option in the top right, and it didn't fix it. I don't have my account linked to anything that I know of, so I'm nervous about even trying to reinstall the game. Beyond this I haven't experienced too many problems.

Best part about the game is getting hit by the same player that's 10 levels above you 10 times in a row so all your resources are gone and your troops are wounded. It's all good though because if your alliance doesn't disband you can heal all of your troops in a month and get your might back. Shamelessly pay to win with no redeeming factors. Very RNG dependent that can have large impacts on your playthrough. I am going to ride out this server until it opens as I am an officer in my current alliance and I really do like the people, but the game itself has been done better in other places. Shameless pay to win includes buying gear you can only get with real money which reduces the resource cost of everything. Buy more resources flat out. Buy speed ups flat out. Buy heroes flat out, many of which you cannot get without spending real money. Events that reward you for spending more money. RNG is mainly the matching games that are included throughout the game. There is an auto-play. Without changing anything and just auto-playing the same game twice I got 4x the score from random chance. These games have a limited number of tries or cost a slowly recharging resource, which you can buy more of for real money, that still is drained if you lose. It costs diamonds to cancel a march and you have no control of your troops once they start walking on the map. Several elements like "the pit" for example have every server from the very beginning in 1 large group making it very uninviting for new players. They have done the heroes very well, all extremely unique and many with overlapping back stories. They are a joy to read when you find two of your favorite characters have history. Though there are no buffs for having them work together. Everything else has been done better elsewhere and some extra features that are not present in others games just take away from the experience. Some people spend hundreds, if not thousands of dollars on this game and I just can't compete with that, nor do I want to.

Would you like to play the card game War? You only start with Aces and Twos, but you can unlock a higher card every month! We promise it's a strategy game! I've been playing this game for 180 days. I have done reasonably well, placing in the Global top 5% of events, and top 25 of free for all events. Here are the pros and cons: 1. Logistics - There's a fun aspect of resource management/gathering in the game. You gather and buy buildings, research, and upgrades. Yay! 2. Events - Once you learn how to manage your sanctuary, you can start timing gains with events, allowing you to get more points, gains, and advancements. This is an addicting part of the game, and one I enjoy figuring out how to do the best at. 3. Puzzles - There is a story campaign that starts, but has no closure. When you reach the end, there is no story, cinematic, or other ending to the 24 levels you fought through. The story drops, and starts over at a harder version of level 1. What's more, the puzzles seem like a challenge until you realize your NPC enemies are either grossly over your power level, or easy enough to be able to be taken by the autoplay function. Sure, you can eek out a manual victory against a hard level once in awhile, but most of the time it is a matter of how much you have upgraded your heroes. 3. Theme - All over the place! Zombie game? Mutant spiders/scorpions? Godzilla mods... puppies and kittens to rescue?! What the hell is going on?! They could do a lot by leaning into the zombie theme and making it immersive, instead of having bits of 10 different genres. 4. Combat - Back to my 'war' analogy. If you are fighting someone who has more stats than you, you lose. There is no strategy, just a greater than/less than result. They do have a Rock, Paper, Scissors mechanic where Riders/Fighters/Shooters have a weakness against one and an advantage over another, however after a certain point that benefit becomes negligible. If you are fighting someone a sanctuary level or two higher than you (I am level 51, Sanctuary level 27), be prepared to lose 100-200 troops for every 1 you take down. When you lose a fight badly, they pop up an advertisement to 'avenge yourself', selling you a bunch of resources and healing speed ups. However, there is absolutely no way you will beat that target. There is no strategic lever to pull, you are just going to lose again. This means in the Alliance vs. Alliance events, or free for all events, there is not a strategy to implement to get ahead, you just have to stay in your lane, picking off the weaker sancs while trying to stay out of the crosshairs of larger ones. 5. Inconsistency - There are some weird bugs in the rally system. You can team up with up to 5 members of your alliance to take down Zombie Lairs. This seems like a cool team building event. However, there is a break in the game the devs refuse to acknowledge (despite screen shots being sent). The way you beat these is to have one person take the primary spot and send a strong troop. Others each provide 1 troop to take part and get rewards, but not have an impact. If you have the 2-6 spots send full troops, you'd think you'd take less casualties and do more damage. However, your casualties will go from 2-3K to 80K+, and damage dealt will be somewhat larger, but not worth the extra loss. This is one of many weird bugs. 6. Pay to Win - I have gotten reasonably far in this game without spending a dime. I like to play on skill, not my wallet, and am okay with others who can buy an edge/time with a few extra bucks. However, there are powerful heroes and equipment that cannot be earned in game. You have to buy them. Then once you buy them, you have to buy upgrades for them. When you get into the PvP arena (Hero Battles), there is no filter/search to challenge people at your power level. You are presented with other players who are 10-50% stronger than you, and get a small reward for losing. To compete, you have to pay. 7. "Customer Service" - An absolute joke. They brush off questions/concerns, and even wave off screenshot evidence.

It's a zombie-themed match-3 puzzle game in a multiplayer PVP fort-building game. I've seen people complaining about deceptive ads but I felt like I knew exactly what the game was going to be heading into it so I don't feel like I agree. However, I would skip the game. I've played plenty of gacha games and am used to the grind, but this game is the worst I've come across with how little progress you make in terms of everything outside of the base building where time boosts are given generously. Survivors are acquired by getting 10 "pieces" which are painstakingly slow to come by. None of the events have offered any progress towards survivors for f2p (maybe further along, but I was looking at rewards that I felt were realistically achievable as f2p). The energy in the campaign gathers slowly (6 minutes per energy, each level costs 10 at the start, then 12, and presumably more later) and energy restores for f2p are non-existent. The second energy source, stamina, is used on the map to gather survivor upgrade and base materials and regenerates at the same rate. In terms of progress I am level 12 at campaign level 9-5 (where progress has slowed tremendously due to stage difficulty) and have 0 5-star survivor shards and a total of 5 4-star shards at a 2-2-1 survivor split. As for my stamina, I have been gathering as much survivor upgrade material as I can, but my survivors are still too weak. In other words, I am nowhere near getting a better survivor to be able to progress further in the campaign. And looking at my screen time this is with 12 hours and 37 minutes of play time (though who knows how efficiently I was using that time).

Ads were misleading, but here we are, 2 years later and I'm still enjoying the game. My best advice for those playing without money or for spending very little, join an alliance for events, and try to maximize rewards, some events overlap and finishing one can also finish another at the same time.

This is the only game where Bejeweled mechanics are actually FUN and add to the gameplay. Previously a 3 star rating based essentially off a pay to win set up I am now reducing to a 1 star because of customer support. The entire experience is frustrating because there is barely any sense of strategy when all the falling pieces are just randomly generated.

Nothing like the advertisement, mobile game advertising is a mess, there is no way anyone should be able to falsely advertise a product.

Pay to play, if not you'll be attacked and robbed of your resources time and time again by higher level players. Time consuming, boring and lacks any kind of storyline. Also, it appears the developer is entering false reviews as to how "great" this game is.

Great artwork. Fun game. Has everything in one game so you don't need to switch lol. I love it. Couldn't figure out why I couldn't change my , what do you call them?, Avitars. Don't be fooled the ads for this game. It's nothing like it. The game is focused around base building and power. Zombies are just a small part of it since you'll mainly be fighting other players. I downloaded this game to win rewards in another app, like one does, but the game looked interesting in general from ads. Love this game! At first I was put off by the ads. I hate match 3 games. But since I like zombies, I decided to give it try. I'm glad I did. I was looking for a game to replace Game of War and i found it. You get to join an alliance, build and upgrade various buildings in your sanctuary. An RTS meets Match 3. The actual match 3 parts take place when you fight zombies. It can lag at times, but other than that, it's perfect.

The game seems to have potential but I am stuck on a part of the tutorial that it wants me to go over to the world map but then it just gets stuck on the loading screen and doesn't actually work. Waited for a solid 5mins and the loading screen keeps spinning and spinning. So due to Game breaking bugs, gotta give it a pretty low ranking!

As others have stated, actual game play doesn't seem much like what the pop-up ads show. Perhaps if I had stayed for higher levels, but I lost interest pretty quickly in basically another match the symbols with big bangs. Didn't see any true puzzles to solve, and the frustratingly lengthy tutorial is very limiting on personal iniative.

Nothing particularly new, interesting, or extraordinary. This game is horrible. This game is a copy paste of so many other games. its completely overflowing with microtransactions. Remember though it is not real PVP; you are merely throwing your base stats around so in the end it becomes about who spends more.

Im only playing this for one of those apps that you can make money in by taking offers. Its pretty bad. Stolen art, bad story, the graphical design makes the game very confusing. But the combination of app genres has some potential, i guess. And its not that bad to play. 2 stars.

Okay, I reviewed a 1 star in 19Jan21. NOTHING I wrote about has changed, instead they’ve added MORE things of the same sort and removed some racial representation from the game. Even better, this game is SUPPOSED TO BE ABOUT ZOMBIES. It is basically a social game where you gather resources, attack other bases, attack a single standing zombie on the field, do alliance quests (half of which have to do with zombies), build your heroes to fight in the arena and help your troops, and do contests (most of which have nothing to do with zombies). As for what I complained about before - Trials still has the pay to get credit task, ads are still false, the game is still extremely money based (they are a business so…)(but if you want to get anywhere, you MUST pay thousands to do so or know the formulas well enough to work around the need), the CS is still mostly cut and paste (meaningless) and for complaints that don’t benefit them to help the player, they always say they’re sending this off to X to be considered or are considering it in some form. They do thank you for your feedback. IN THE MEANTIME, the game has MASSIVE lag issues that they NEVER address. They just keep adding states and animations and ignoring the issue while telling you, “We will forward this concern… blah blah.” They have added quests in alliance showdown “? Quests” that you have to PAY to finish (buy 15 things from the mall) or you loose one of your attempts. Okay… that is kind of forceful. And that quest does NOT belong in the ? quests. A CHOICE, yes. RANDOM, no. Also, they have put a white blonde bombshell as the icon (when previously you had a racial choice) for a gear and Fox Trial icon. They said more choices would be available MONTHS ago but nothing happened. I am not a white blonde bombshell (Amber). I HIGHLY resent this especially when there was choice before. Also, the freebies they give in contests are HIGHLY “pay at the mall” or be super powerful (pay at the mall) oriented. I have been trying at Nukaland (a gathering contest) for MONTHS to try to get fragments, no luck. I always get JUST to the edge and never past it. Nukaland, by the way, has NOTHING to do with zombies… as a matter of fact, most of their added games have nothing to do with zombies. So if you like the zombie theme, forget this game. It is a hunt and gather social game with base to base fighting and hero building. I pay money sometimes. NOT the thousands some players pay, but I pay. If you don’t pay thousands, don’t pay ANY attention to the feedback – you absolutely don’t matter when it comes to what I am complaining about. In short, one star is still appropriate as the developers never deal with the big things but keep adding things that make no difference to the players but tend to increase the problems. So, why do I stay? I have a social network I like. We have fun. Other than that, I would ditch the game and constantly struggle with doing so.
